title: Buy Two Than Switch Key Holders

title: Don’t get the scrunch
text:
I’m torn on these leggings.

Pros:
very comfy. I LOVE how soft and smooth they are. The material is stretchy, like rubber band elastic stretchy. not too thick or thin or see through. I get the “naked” feeling for sure and they look pretty “naked” as well, like a second,smoother skin.

I run a lot so I put a few miles on these leggings and they held up beautifully. they are supportive and breathable, don’t roll down or sag. Surprisingly didn’t show any sweat despite the light grey color which is GORGEOUS.

The rise is high enough to cover my belly button. Length is great for full length on 5’8”. Sizing was true. 128lbs, I got small.

Cons:
After one wash (while being in a delicate laundry bag) I noticed loose strings from the ankle seam. I’m hoping these aren’t falling apart already.

My black boy shorts undies did show thru these a little. The grey is not 100% squat proof.

The bum scrunch looks like a bum hole :/ I even got a second opinion which was the same. I don’t have a big booty so maybe it would look nice if you had a perfect peach like the model. I thought they would enhance my booty, but it only looks worse.

I have to go with a solid 3 for these but
I highly recommend the non scrunch version!!!

title: Nice product, good construction and details.  Sturdy and stable.
text:
I'm not an expert on trekking poles-- these are the first I've purchased. My motivation is improved stability when hiking on my beat-up knees. These fill the bill. They assemble quickly, are very lightweight, and they seem sturdy. The tungsten-carbide tips are great for dirt trails, and they come with screw-on plastic mud/snow baskets and rubber tips for hard surfaces. Everything fits into an included carrying bag.

The carbon fiber construction seems authentic and not some sort of veneer over a lesser material. The poles come out of their bag folded in thirds like a magician's trick wand. There's a spring cord inside that holds everything together, and when you extend the upper shaft it pulls everything taut. A little button on the upper shaft pops out to keep everything firmly extended. It's easy to press when you want to fold everything up again, and there's no way that will happen accidentally.

The fitments are machined aluminum and slide together nicely, with no slop. The cork grip deserves special mention: It's firm but absorbent of sweat, so it never gets slippery. The top tube has a graduated scale so you can reproduce a desired length each time. One of my poles' handpieces is maybe 0.5-0.7cm longer than the other, so the numbers differ by that much. But, your arms probably differ by as much too... bottom line, they are easily and quickly adjusted for comfort and stability for both arms.

So far I'm quite satisfied with my purchase. I'm sure that by spending twice as much for a set of Lekis you might get something even nicer, but these are great.

text: I'll admit, I got this mainly to work in the garden - my other hat doesn't provide enough shade for my face/back of the neck. This one does since it has a large brim both front and back. It comes in a nice, breathable bag for packing/travel, and it does fold/collapse if you want to pack it for a trip. It's not the most elegant thing, I'll admit, but it does the job of keeping the sun off your face, it's comfortable and it fits my head well.

title: very soft, nice thickness to it
text:
This 'pashima' scarf is what I tend to notice anymore a generic label for a very soft scarf/shawl - yes, it has some wool (25%) and cashmere (25%) in it, with the rest being polyester, but I wouldn't consider it to be a true 'pashmina' scarf. That said, it is very soft and is thick enough that you don't see through it at all, unlike with most cashmere scarves (unless they are VERY expensive). It's almost 80" long without the fringe, and almost 30" wide, so it covers the shoulders and hangs down one's back, and can be wrapped around to provide warmth as a shawl or knotted in cute ways for a scarf.
It's very soft, definitely a nice touch around one's neck or against the face, and with the polyester in this I'm fine with washing it (delicate cycle, in a bag for protection, cold wash, hang to dry. The non-fringe ends look as if they were just cut, no stitched seems, but the material is such that as its worn, it should 'mat' together. All and all, this is a lovely, large wrap that's so soft and will provide some warmth during the cooler months at a great price point (especially considering the fact that I've lost a couple over time - I'll be sad but not as sad as if this was the real thing). Also, lots of color options.

title: nothing too fancy
text: This is basically a tunic with a little embellishment (the buttons on the v-neck and the 3/4 sleeves) that's mostly soft (poly-spandex blend). I like the oatmeal color, it's a nice neutral, and it's a bit thicker than most tunics so it provides more coverage, but not much else to say about it. The top could do for more casual work environments and with jeans or leggings, and for a large, it doesn't seem too 'big'. Might want to size up.

title: cute layered necklace with extender
text: This is a really cute layered necklace with 'rose gold' plated over brass - it's a fashionable color and the ferris wheels (circles with faux diamonds/crystals) sparkle and spin around the chain, which are great if you like to fidget with things or for a bit of shine. The chain is the usual thin one you get for this price point, but the clasp is easy to open/close and you can extend the necklace two inches past the 16" (I like mine short). It comes in a lovely gift box and bag, with a cleaning cloth and a cute card, which makes it perfect for gift giving.

title: cute t-shirt
text: While this t-shirt is funny all year round, it's especially so for the Halloween season. I love the grey color and font, and the 'children stay free' line. It's comfortable and a nice weight, and washes up well.

title: Lovely lemon dress!
text: Sweet little dress and hat! For $12.99 I was able to buy a unique gift for my niece. It's well sewn, nice fabric and the dress is lined. There is a zipper and elastic under the arms. The hat is adorable, but could use a ribbon.

title: The fabric is light and flowy
text: I do like this, but it's cut for a woman with no hips. I ordered an XL, I am usually a US12. So size up. The top is for someone taller, I am 5'3". Overall, it's pretty, and would be perfect for a tall, slim hipped woman.

title: Ver pretty...
text: I wear a US12, and ordered an XL. It is super fitted. Which isn't horrible, but I got red and it is very tomato. Not dark red like the photo. So it's going back, the color is awful on me. Quality is good. I am 5'3" and it touches the floor. I might order another color. The fabric is flowy and princessy, lace is not itchy. Overall a nice dress.

title: Three Stars
text: Not the material I was expecting.  And the tag left a sizeable hole in the pocket.

title: I don't think that these will last very long with regular wear.
text:
The backs come off really easily. I think it's only a short matter of time before they're lost.
The prongs holding the jewel in are pretty flimsy, and easy to bend. I don't think that these will last very long with regular wear.

title: Three Stars
text: Lace top isn't very durable.

title: tight chest
text: it's too tight across the chest.

title: Four Stars
text: really nice bag

title: Cute bag.
text: Was dubious whether or not to keep it.  I kept it.

title: Great purchase for me
text: Love these glasses……would buy again

title: great shirt for the price
text: Do to multiple back surgeries, I like to wear compression shirts to help if my back gets sore. I usually wear Tommy Copper brand but wanted something a little easier on the wallet. So far I like the material it's made of. It doesn't ride up as easily as others do. I do wish I could have found this in a normal tshirt style as opposed to a muscle shirt. My only issue is that I wear between a XXL and XXXL depending on which brand shirt I buy, so I purchased a XXL compression shirt. Once I tried it on, it was too big so I exchanged it for a XL which is not quite as tight as I'd like but it will work. Overall, considering the price and quality, I will order more.

title: Nice looking band but more like rubber than "Genuine" Leather
text: Nice looking, flexible watch band. The picture is a very accurate representation of the color. I have a big wrist and the watch fits with 2 holes to spare. My one complaint is that it feels and acts much more like a rubber material than "genuine" leather as the description states.

title: beautiful piece
text: This pin was gorgeous, bright and vibrant and the words are very legible. I really like it.

title: Everything I hoped and more.
text:
Fashionable.
Comfortable.
Affordable.
Available in fun colors.
Will probably order more.

title: Quality product at an affordable price.
text: Mehr makes quality products. I love that they aren’t real expensive and yet look like it. I have the valet key chain in red, and ordered this one (Classic, multi-ring) in black.  I thought it would be a nice token gift for my husband. I like that it is neutral (unisex) and anyone can use it. It is black leather and chrome. The only difference that I will note, between the two keyrings, is that unlike the valet one, you can’t really remove the keys as easily. However, this keyring comes with three individual rings, that you can attach to the larger ring. This is perfect if you don’t carry a lot of keys, or if your car key is not bulky. **Note, some of the new cars have those big fobs which might not fit. However, because these keychains are so inexpensive (under $10), they make the  perfect gifts. For example, brides and grooms can purchase these for the bridal/bachelor party.  They would be perfect stocking stuffers, or gifts for co-workers. I’d highly recommend the Mehr brand and their products.

title: Whether you are a fan or not…
text: Whether a fan of the Washington Wizards or not, this is a decent t-shirt. It’s black and has the Wizard logo trimmed in a thin red line. It fits true to size and looks great with jeans. The only warning that I will provide the purchaser is that this it does shrink a little, so be careful when washing. **I also received a Boston Celtics t.

title: Stylish and affordable.
text:
These jeans fit true to size.
They are fashionable and comfortable.
They are a nice color with popular embellishments (holes strategically placed along the upper leg).
They fit true to size.
They will match most things, sweaters, shirts and hoodies.
The wash well.
I’d recommend them.

title: Pretty.
text: I really like this dress. It is comfortable and flattering. The material is machine washable. I like that it has pockets, that accent the outfit. Now all I need is the right color jacket or sweater to go with it. I'd recommend it.

title: Chic and very fashionable.
text: The Crntzsis scarf/shawl/wrap is very pretty.  It is red and charcoal. The pattern is large checkered blocks (i.e., plaid). The pattern isn’t overpowering, even subtle. This scarf is soft and feels great around your shoulder or neck. The fabric is a blend of cashmere and polyester.  It does not itch or irritate my skin. It is a nice size, which makes it easy to drape around your shoulders or neck. It can be worn dressy or casually and goes with everything from jeans to a skirt. It is reversable, which is a really nice feature. There isn’t too much fringe (it is short and discrete), which makes it look more expensive even though it retails for less than $25.  Overall, I think this is a pretty sweet accessory that would make a nice gift for yourself or someone else.

title: Babydoll!
text: The Sonja Betro Knit/Lace Sleeve Babydoll Tunic is cute. It is oversized and comfortable. The fabric is cool (100% cotton) and easy to maintain (machine washable). You can wear it with leggings, jeans or shorts. I would describe it as having an empire waistline with slight gathers. My only warning is that it has the potential to make you look fat if you aren’t careful, depending on your body shape. Overall, 4 stars.

title: Bohemian delight.  3.5-4 stars
text: In a nutshell, the Sunsoul Tribal Boho Gypsy Brass Bangle Bracelets are super cute. This set comes with 4 bangles. The two thick ones have a “hammered” design and the two thinner ones have a “faint” leaf-like design. I had absolutely no issue slipping these light-weight bracelets on. They are affordable and can be worn causally. They look really cute with jeans and an oversized shirt. And finally, these come in a trendy drawstring, burlap bag that makes them perfect for gift giving. Overall, these make the perfect accessory for a a causal outfit.

title: Soft and practical.
text: The Woman’s Ultra Soft Fleece Chevron Pullover Hoodie is very soft and very practical. The design is nice. There are three colors (black, white and gray) that form the design. There is a drawstring at the neck that you can use to adjust the neck. It is soft and fits true to size. And finally, it is machine washable. I did not notice any shrinkage. I'd recommend it.

title: 2 for the price 1.
text: To me the Ldriance CZ & bar is a hit. You get two trendy necklaces (complementary designs) for the price of one. One is a bar and the other is a circle. They can be worn together or separately. They are dainty and very feminine. They are 14kt gold plated pieces, and I did not notice any irritation to my skin. These necklaces are nickel free and hypoallergenic. They can be worn casually or dressy. They are super cute, fun and reasonably priced.  I’d recommend these for yourself or someone else.

title: Wrap up. 4.5 stars
text: The HETH plaid blanket scarf is soft and warm. The fabric is 100% acrylic, but feels more expensive. The colors are basic (tan/camel with black and cream accents) and will match everything. There is fringe that accents/complements the design. I like that this is a pretty versatile scarf. You can dress it up or wear it casually with jeans. And if you are clever and know how to create a variety of knots and designs, you can wear it alone, or with your coat or jacket. Finally, this scarf is very affordable and comes in a variety of colors. This is the perfect gift for someone that enjoys scarves or shawls.

title: A must have or staple for your closet.
text: This beautiful blue Missky dress is lovely. I like it more than I thought I would. The color, a deep royal blue is vivid and bold. It is flattering and comfortable. The fabric is breathable. It is a combination of cotton, polyamide and spandex. There is a convenient zipper down the back. You can wear this dress up with a blazer or wear it casually with some fun jewelry and strappy sandals. I was worried about the fit, but the 2XL fits like an XL. The hem line (shorter in the front and longer in the back) complements all body types. And finally, the cost of this dress makes it worth trying. When you consider the look and the cost, this is a steal, a MUST HAVE really. 5 stars

title: Maxi-fabulous.
text: The Aooksmery Patchwork Maxi dress is super comfortable and fun. It fits true to size. The neckline and colors (oatmeal, beige and purple) are flattering. The patchwork design is very pretty too. The only thing that I will say is that I am short (about 5’4) and this dress is kind-of long. I will definitely either have to hem it or make sure that I tie it in the suggested knot, although I am sure that you could also wear it with some heels. But man, if I were about 5’10 or even taller (which I always wished I had been), it would be perfect.  Overall, I am pleased and plan to rock this dress.

title: Support + function = style.
text: The Xuesnrol Front Closure Bra is nice. I love the front closure. It’s easy to put on and remove. The cups have underwire and mold the breasts well. The straps are adjustable. There are some nice lace accents that enhance the front of the bra (beige). In the end, this is a decent bra that’s comfortable.

title: Great costume jewelry!
text:
Inexpensive. Reasonably priced.
Very pretty.
The center stone is a rich color (green) surrounded by tiny CZ stones.
It is easy to secure to your ear.
You can wear these with your hair up or down.
Wear them when you are dressed up or down (casually).
The metal does not irritate my skin or cause redness.
Definitely a must have.
5 stars

title: A little bling. 4.5 stars
text: Primesons’ 18kt gold plated CZ earrings are very pretty.  They don’t look like real diamonds but look great as costume jewelry. They don’t look too gaudy or busy. They are versatile. You can wear your hair up or down or dress them up (fancy dress or pantsuit) or down (jeans and a cute sweater). They are lightweight and comfortable in your ears. I have sensitive skin and haven’t noticed any redness or irritation on my ears after wearing them. The only tricky thing is the closure, which took me some time to get use to. You have to maneuver a prong into the hole when closing. Once secured, you are good to go. And finally, these earrings are affordable. They would be great as bridesmaid’s gifts, or to give someone special. I’d recommend them.

title: Beautiful color, great coverage.
text: This HSIA underwire bra has become one of my favorites. The color is beautiful (a rich burgundy). It’s comfortable and provides great coverage and support (underwire doesn’t bite/pinch). The straps are wide and adjustable. I’m excited to recommend this bra! It’s fantastic.

title: Extremely flattering.
text: Aookmery has created a very pretty dress. The color is lovely (dark green with a hint of blue, although not teal). The design (lace overlay with an eyelet design) is flattering. The sleeves are long, and the neckline high and round. It looks just as great with your hair up as it does down. The fabric is comfortable and breathable (100% polyester). It is very flattering, I think due to the high waist. You can wear it with a jacket and some heels. I personally wore minimal jewelry because the dress itself makes such a statement. It needs very little to complement it. I’d recommend it.

title: Breathtaking lounging gown.
text: Alexander Del Rossa’s Satin sleep shirt is very pretty, breathtaking even. The pattern is intricate and nostalgic. I would consider it to be Japanese inspired. The design/style is called “Yellow Flowers on Cream”. The base color is a yellowish-gold, with yellow roses, green leaves and burnt red trees strategically placed throughout. I consider the style of the collar to be nero or mandarin like. The sleeves are ¾ length. The fabric is lightweight, satiny and smooth. Really comfortable. I am not sure that I would necessarily wear this to bed (it’s too nice), but I would definitely wear this to lounge or hang around the house.  I wanted it to be roomy, so I ordered this in a 2XL. I’m glad because it fits more like an XL. Overall, this is the perfect lounging gown and I love it.

title: Baby doll cuteness.
text: This White Ofenbuy Lace Eyelet dress is super cute. Baby doll cuteness. This dress is v-neck and sleeveless. It is fun and fanciful. You can sassy it up with fancy jewelry (chunky or turquoise), along with some cute strappy sandals. In conclusion, this dress is perfect for that summer outing with your special someone. I’d recommend it for all ages.

title: The perfect gift.
text: This Swiss Reimagined billfold is perfect for most men. It is a traditional wallet that can hold your ID, credit cards and cash easily. It is RFID protected. The craftmanship is great. This wallet is black (leather) with light colored stitching (that doesn’t distract from the look). I gifted this to my son, who was in the need of another one. I’d recommend it.

title: Wow, what a beautiful casual dress! 4.5 stars
text: I live in Atlanta, where the weather is moderate enough that I could wear this now (with a denim jacket), but to be honest I can’t wait until summer gets here so that I can really rock this Lacavocor maxi dress . The top is a solid black tank with a floral bottom. The colors that create the floral print complement each other (grey, tan, red, black & mauve). The fabric is comfortable (a blend of cotton, polyester and spandex).  My only warning is that I received this in a 2XL and it fits like an XL, so I say it runs small. Overall, this is a beautiful dress that I would recommend.

title: Color me wine!
text: The Timeson Women’s lace blouse is perfect to wear with slacks, a skirt or even jeans. It is lightweight and cool. The fabric, which is 100% polyester (Chiffon) is comfortable and feels great against your skin. The color is beautiful (wine/burgundy), and the neckline is accented by a lace design. The pleat in the front can hide imperfections, if you have a belly (I do so I appreciate it). This blouse is very versatile, you can wear the shirt inside or out. It looks great either way. And finally, this shirt fits true to size. I’d recommend it.

title: Floral delight.
text: This dress by CUQY floral print dress is very pretty. The fabric is breathable and comfortable. The base color of the dress is black with colorful (i.e., red, gold, blue and pale green) flowers. You can add a jacket or cardigan and wear to work. You can wear sandals or heels and add some fun jewelry. I’d recommend this dress to anyone.

title: The Trinity.
text: These Chance the Rapper inspired hats come in red and black. This two pack is reasonably priced. They are stylish and have a positive message (father, son and holy ghost). I gave one to each of my sons. Hopefully they will be inspired to make a positive impact on society.

title: The perfect summer or lounging dress.
text: This cute little winered (combination of red and wine) dress by IVVIC is perfect for the summer. You can wear it with a denim jacket or thin cardigan, flats or sandals. The fabric (blend of rayon and spandex) is breathable and comfortable.  It has a round neck and is short sleeved. The hem is asymmetric which makes it a little unique. It also has pockets, which I like (even though I might not use them). It runs a little small so keep that in mind when ordering. And finally, it is machine washable. I wash on gentle and then hang dry. In conclusion, I think this is a cute dress that women of all ages can enjoy.

title: Super cute. Just HUG-IT-OUT!
text:
The Hugitout (14kt gold plated) layered necklace is cuter than I expected. The color is pretty, rose gold. It’s very dainty. You have two strands that create a really cute choker. The lower strand is interspersed with tiny letters, D’s and C (which works out since those are my sons’ initials). The upper strand has a few cubic zirconia clusters, which accent the entire design. The chain is about 16in with the built-in extender. This necklace looks lovely with tops or sweaters that have round necklines. It will appeal to all ages (from teens to adults) and will complement most outfits. I have sensitive skin and liked the fact that even though this is costume jewelry it did not irritate my skin (nickel free & lead free). And finally, if you want to give this as a gift, it is perfect because it comes with a cute box, a cleaning cloth, drawstring bag and thank you card (from the company).

**Note: After wearing this cute necklace twice, it broke. Unfortunately, I couldn't determine how to contact the seller to see about a replacement. Therefore, I reduced the stars from 4 to 2. If it were more durable, it would definitely get my original 4 stars.

title: Cute concept with a Bohemian flair.
text: These Les umes pants are super cute and fashionable. They are black, flair legged pants with a colorful ribbon down the sides. They seem to run a little large and are a little long, so you might want to wear them with some heels. The material (a cotton/polyester blend) is thick, jersey like material (kind of like sweatshirt material) but is very comfortable. There is an elastic waistband and pockets. You can wear these with a sweatshirt or blouse. My only criticism would be that they run a little long, so the taller you are the better these would probably hang. Overall, these are worth 4 stars.

title: Beautiful 4.5 stars
text: The Glamcarat sterling-silver Celtic knot cross is very pretty. Prettier than I expected. The pendant, an intricate Celtic knot/cross/heart, is about the size of a nickel or a little bigger. The sterling silver chain is 18” so it hangs nicely on the neck, at the throat. The length will appeal to ladies of all ages. This necklace comes with a cleaning cloth, which will help it stay clean and shiny. It does come in a box, that isn’t fancy, but perfect for gift-giving. I really like it and would recommend it for yourself or someone else.

title: Nautically inspired. 3.5 stars
text: These Alboria PJs are super comfortable. They are navy blue and white (the striped accent at the throat, hem and trimming the shorts), nautically inspired. This two-piece set is lightweight and comfortable. The fabric is a delightful blend of polyester and spandex. The top is short sleeved, and the shorts are traditional, not cute short. However, be careful when ordering. These do appear to run small. And finally, the pockets are a nice touch but totally unnecessary. Overall, these are decent. I give them 3.5 stars.

title: Cool look. Cool feel.
text: My 6’3 son loves three things: video games (FortNite), sleep and jogging pants. So, these Lazy One joggers fit the bill and he loves them. They have a cool look with a fun design. These are green, gray, black, white and blue. They have an elastic waistband with drawstring. The pockets are roomy and deep. They can be worn as jogging pants or pajamas. They are comfortable and machine washable. My son is 6’3, 170lbs and an XL fits him perfectly. Finally, these are reasonably priced. Kid approved.

title: Style meets function. 4.5 stars
text: This nightgown by Cososa is super cute. Classic, old fashion meets function. It is plaid (yellow, blue and cream) with a thick ribbon straps (sweet is written in cursive on one). It comes to the knees. It is very comfortable. The fabric is 100% polyester. It’s very comfortable, cool and comes to my knees.  My only criticism is that there is only one pocket? If you are going to have a pocket, why not two? Or just don’t have pockets, since it is a nightgown. What can you really do with one pocket, and if that wasn’t how it is intended, mine has a flaw in the construction. Overall, this is a cute nightgown. I’d recommend it.

title: Runs small. Order up.
text: This Yozly tie dye nightgown looks like cotton candy (white, pink and blue). The design is like a v-neck oversized t-shirt, but it is kind of fitted. That’s my biggest complaint, it seems to run small. The length stops mid-thigh. I like my nightgowns to be oversized, so would have preferred this nightie to be bigger. And since this fabric is 100% cotton, it might shrink after washing which is why I would also recommend that you hang dry after machine washing.

title: Love the look but runs small in the chest.
text: I love the look of this Charis Allure striped dress. The green pinstripes are accented with white stripes. It reminds me of something retro. The dress buttons down the front and has a belt. The collar is feminine. The (sheer) fabric is light and comfortable. There is even a cute little ruffle that accentuates the hem. Now the bad part, the fit at the top. It fits extremely small. I wear a size 40DD bra so the top gaps open in the front when buttoned. So, I can’t say that this fits true to size – in the hips it is fine, but the top is small and fits more like a medium than an XL. Overall, I will give this dress 4 stars for the look but 2 for the fit, so a solid 3.

title: What a pretty floral dress.
text: This v-neck/faux wrap dress by Msbasic is super cute. It wraps slightly in the front (I wore mine with a coral tank underneath). It has very pretty sleeves – flutter style. There is a side zipper which makes it convenient. It has a very nice hemline, stops right above the knee. The base color of the dress is navy blue, with a floral design. The flowers are bold yet subtle (yeah, I know that is a contradiction) – cream, soft pink and red roses. The material is satiny and comfortable against my skin. I like that this dress is machine washable (cool and hang-dry). It is perfect for a summer BBQ. I’d recommend it.

title: I expected a little more.
text: This Rilney tote is very pretty, summery even. Unfortunately, it is very thin. It has a denim looking body with brown/tan (leather) handles and bottom. It is lined. I expected something a little heavier or more substantial. This is more of a gift bag or beach bag. As a matter of fact, this bag is perfect for a beach trip (which is where I’d be if it weren’t for this pandemic). I can definitely see carrying a small wallet, a paperback novel, suntan lotion and sunglasses in it, but wouldn’t recommend putting anything too heavy in it.  So, while I am disappointed (that it isn’t more substantial), I am sure that I will find a use for it.

title: Casual cuteness.
text:
These Delebao sneakers are:
SUPER CUTE.
Classic design (white with faux laces).
Perfect for causal wear.
Come with bonus, basic white socks.
ARE affordable.
Perfect as a shower gift.

title: Semi-cute. Looks better in the photo.
text: While the Byinns sweater looks better in photos than in person, it still has a lot of potential. It looks well made in the photos, but in person, it appears to be a bit cheap. The material (acrylic) is soft, but I can tell that it will look worn over time.  The color (sky blue) and pattern (weave) are nice. I wore it with gray slacks and a jacket, but it can be worn with most colors like navy, black or khaki. However, don’t fear, this sweater can even be worn casually with jeans. Just add some cute jewelry and you are good to go.

title: Festive and cheerful.
text: I ordered these festive pajamas for my husband to wear Christmas morning. They are going to look great on him while we open gifts Christmas morning. They are super cute. The two-piece set includes plaid thermal underpants with a long-sleeved shirt. Woven throughout the pants are snowflakes and reindeer. On the chest of the shirt is a large reindeer with a banner which reads Christmas. The top is a baseball jersey with gray sleeves. The pants have a plaid design of cranberry and cream. Overall, I give these 4 stars because they are festive and cheerful.

title: A little disappointed.
text: This Torary shirt has a very pretty print. The shirt is black with a floral design. The flowers are pink, green, yellow and blue. The design can be casual or dressy. You can wear with jeans or under a jacket. The fabric is 100% polyester. There is a one button enclosure. It is comfortable. My only criticism is that it is a little cheap looking up close but great at a distance. For the cost, it is worth taking a look. 3.5 stars.

title: More PJs for the pandemic.
text: The Swomog pjs are soft and comfortable. The color is a pretty blue. The rayon and spandex material is cool. The pants are cropped, and the shirt is short sleeve. The hem of the pants and sleeves are slightly scalloped.  These are perfect for lounging around the house. I like them.

title: Had potential but runs small.
text: I can’t wait until summer to wear this little II InIn sleeveless tank dress. It is bold with colorful stripes (white, yellow, green, red and pink). You can wear it alone or with a cute little cardigan or jacket. While I have plenty of room in the hips, the top is a little small. So, if you are busty, I would suggest ordering up. The material, a blend of spandex and cotton, is comfortable and feels good against your skin. This dress pairs well with a variety of shoe colors and styles. Bonus: It has pockets too!

title: Wearing it brings back sweet memories.
text: This t-shirt is super cute. There is a strawberry shortcake ice cream popsicle on a soft grey t-shirt (minus a bite). It celebrates 100 years of Good Humor. It does run small so be careful when ordering or washing. Wearing it does bring back memories of my childhood.

title: I can hear the ice cream truck coming!
text: This nostalgic inspired tee-shirt is perfect. It is heather blue/navy with the slogan (with the popsicle logo) reminiscent of my childhood - “If it’s popsicle – It’s possible.” It seems to run a little small, so definitely order up, especially if you aren’t going to be careful when you wash it.  But wearing it reminds you of a hot summer day, hearing the bell ringing while waiting for the ice cream truck to stop.

title: Everyone can use a pair of classic gold hoops.
text: I love hoop earrings. These AllenCOCO earrings are medium sized, 18kt gold plated, sterling silver earrings. They are affordable (under $20). They are lightweight and comfortable. They did not irritate my skin or ears. They are anti-tarnish and anti-allergy. You can dress them up or down. They will be just as cute with jeans as a suit.  I highly recommend them.

title: Can't wait until it is summer.
text: This “sweet” little dress by Liumilac has me ready for the summer. It is extremely flattering and comfortable. It is black with small yellow flowers. It has spaghetti straps and a ruffled hem. The straps are adjustable. You can dress it up or down. Very slimming and feminine. It even has pockets. All you have to do is add some cute jewelry, comfortable shoes and a cute cardigan. And finally, it fits true to size. I’d recommend it.

title: Call me lucky.
text: Enzomar’s four leaf clover necklace is pretty. The rose gold chair is accented with a purple and green stoned 4 leaf clover (some may refer to it as shamrock). The pendant isn’t really that large, equal to or a little smaller than a dime. The Swarovski crystals are subtle but definitely add something special to the design. Overall, this is super cute especially if you like 4 leaf clovers or are fortunate enough to be born on St. Patrick's Day. This necklace is very giftable for either yourself or someone else.

title: Fun for work or play.
text: This Knitee dress is super fashionable. The color is a beautiful cranberry/burgundy. The fabric, a blend of polyester and spandex, is comfortable, stretchy, and breathable. There is a lapel, with a cute tie. Very feminine.  It zips up the back and is accented with a small split at the hem. Just enough to be playful yet professional. You can wear this at work or play (out to eat with friends). The cut is flattering but will show your flaws if you have any (i.e., stomach, hips and thighs). This dress stops at the knee. And finally, I will warn you that this dress runs small, so please order up.

title: Bling baby. Bling!
text: What a nice piece of costume jewelry. This Enzomar pendant necklace is breathtaking and looks better than I thought it would in person. The pendant is 925 sterling silver and reminds me of on open “C.” It is encrusted with cubic zirconia stones and is suspended on a chain, that is sturdy and durable. It has just enough bling without being too much. The pendant is between the size of a quarter and a half-dollar. It is hypoallergenic and doesn’t irritate my skin. I would recommend this necklace for yourself or someone else.

title: Fabric could have been better, although these are comfortable.
text:
These joggers by Vivienne are worthy of 3.5 stars. Why?

1. The material is soft, although thin.
2. They are comfortable.
3. The waistband is wide and can be (a) folded down or (b) gathered.
4. They fit true to size or I would suggest sizing down if I were honest. These are also nice since they can camouflage problem areas like the hips, stomach and thighs.
5. The jogger legs are flattering and feminine.
6. They don’t have pockets.

In conclusion, I can only give these a 3.5 because while the material is soft, it is mostly rayon which means after a few washes, they look a little worn. But in terms of laying around the house or running errands, these can be your go to pants.

title: What a beautiful watch. 4.5 stars
text: What a lovely watch. I was really surprised about the quality of this Nbonal watch. It is very attractive! Very pleasing to the eye! The band is a white silicone band that can be adjusted. The bezel and accents (minute, hour and second hands) are rose gold. The face has a pearl finish and is easy to read. It is very comfortable, super fashionable and can be worn dressy or casually. This watch is a welcomed addition to my growing watch collection.

title: A blast to my past.
text: These earrings by Rimayzi remind me of some I had in the 90s, which is probably what attracted me to them in the first place. They are 18K gold plated, with a solid base/disk and multiple oval rings. They dangle (but don’t jingle) and are fun. They can be worn dressy or casual. They are lightweight, comfortable in the ear and don’t irritate my skin.

title: Whimsical and fun.
text: I love watches and find it very difficult not to buy them. This watch by Princess Butterfly is whimsical and fun. It will appeal to women of all ages. The bracelet is silver. The face has a colorful dial that reminds me of rainbows/blades. There is a combination of numbers and Roman numerals to denote the hour. They are easy to read, even with my middle-aged eyes. Tiny crystals are embedded in the bezel which add just the right amount of bling but not too much.  And finally, this watch is affordable. For around $60 (on Amazon), you can get a decent gift for yourself or someone else.

title: A simple dress.
text: This is a simple and very comfortable dress. The color is a light, soft green. I would describe it as a muted celery. It is flowy/billowy (not sure if those are real words). It comes to the knee and ties on the shoulders. It is a great weekend dress.  Inexpensive and functional. I’d recommend it.

title: Nightie Night.
text: This 2-piece set by Hefunige is super nice and comfortable. It is purplish grey. The top is a tank, and the shorts have an elastic waistband. The fabric, a viscose and spandex blend, is super cool and breathable. It fits true to size, but I’d recommend ordering up if you don’t like stuff to be fitted.

title: Nice concept but too tight. Runs too small.
text: I really loved the concept of this dress – the color and the style. It is a faux suede, nero collared dress with a large zipper down the front. The fabric is soft and comfortable. It is also stretchy, which should mean that it was forgiving, but unfortunately it isn’t. I’m curvy which isn’t a good thing to be if you want to wear this dress. It was definitely too tight and too small. I even had trouble zipping it over my 40DD chest so I will be returning this dress. However, if you can get the sizing right, I’d recommend it.

title: Very cute. Glad I got it.
text: This 14K gold plated charm bracelet is super cute. It has a flat mesh band, versus the traditional link or chain style bracelet. It like that it is two-toned, silver and gold. Attached to the bracelet are sun and moon themed charms with stones. They are dainty and feminine. This bracelet is comfortable to wear and doesn’t catch on your clothing. There is a nice magnetic clasp that secures the bracelet on your arm. Overall, this is a find and would work nicely as a gift for the woman that you love or really any woman in your life. It would make a nice gift. I’d recommend it.

title: A dainty timepiece.
text: This is a very pretty timepiece. I was not familiar with the Daniel Wellington brand but I am impressed. This is a beautiful watch. The band is rose gold mesh and the face is rectangular shaped (eggshell/white). It is very dainty and elegant. It has a very classic design that is timeless and will appeal to women of all ages. The clasp is simple and easy to close. I would recommend this watch.

title: Unique and lovely.
text: This necklace by Enzomar is unique and eye-catching. The pendant (shaped like a disc) is about the size of a quarter and has a black base/tone. The chain is 925 sterling silver with a rose gold overlay. It is encrusted with clear stones of various shapes and sizes. The length of the chain is nice. This necklace can be worn on a variety of occasions, dressy or casual. It’s just as cute with jeans as it is with a dress. And finally, it is inexpensive and great addition to my costume jewelry. I would recommend it for ladies of all ages.

title: "Bling"
text: This Water Drop necklace by Enzomar is stunning. I like it a lot more than I thought I would. The tear drop (oval) pendant is encrusted with cubic zirconia/Swarovski stones. The chain/pendant setting is sterling silver (925).  The length of the chain is great. The necklace itself isn’t heavy. I have sensitive skin and did not notice any irritation or redness. It is easy to put on and take off. This necklace is hypoallergenic and nickel-free. It can be worn with a dress, suit or jeans, so it is versatile. Overall, this is an eye-catching necklace that will appeal to women of all ages. I really like it and would highly recommend it.

title: Holiday parties here I come!
text: Hopefully by the holidays this Pandemic stuff will be a thing of the past. In all of our rearview mirrors and we will be having parties to celebrate surviving these challenging times. At least that is what I was hoping when I selected this dress by Haokeke. The color is pretty (festive). I would describe it as a dark teal. The style is feminine. The dress is lace inspired but lined, so you can’t see through it. It is conservative – round collar and long sleeves, but very stylish. It is flattering, slimming, and camouflages my problem areas (stomach and hips). It is 100% polyester and has a side zipper. My only warning is that I suggest ordering up because it does seem to run a little small (but I’m still going to rock it!). Overall, this is a cute dress that I think a lot of ladies will enjoy especially during the holiday season.

title: A t-shirt dress that I will use as nightgown. 3.0 stars
text: This is a cute little navy blue, long-sleeved shirt with white writing. I will use it more as a nightgown than dress. It is comfortable and has a positive message “When you can’t find the Sunshine, Be the sunshine” on the front. Overall, I don’t like this as a dress, but a nightshirt yes!

title: Ill fitting, and not as flattering as the photo.
text: I really thought I’d like these pajamas, but realized that they weren’t as cute as I’d hoped when my husband asked, “what is going on with those pjs?” And before you start thinking it, I wasn’t hurt because I knew what he meant. They made me look like a confused Victorian woman! There are long sleeves, a scalloped/ruffle neck and hem. Really, I look like a woman who couldn’t decide if she wanted to be hip or conservative. Here is a summary. The GOOD THINGS: (1) the color is a pretty (periwinkle) blue; (2) The fabric is thicker than a tee-shirt and moderately comfortable. AND finally (3) these pajamas have pockets. Who doesn’t like a good pocket? BAD THINGS: (1) The pockets. Ok, while they seem cool and a nice style design, the question remains why do you really need pockets in your pajamas? The most you can do is bury your hands in them so really what is the point.  (2) The top fits kind of like a mid-drift of sorts. And the shorts are kind of short. (3) The neck and hem are scalloped/ruffled. An element design which should have been cute, but again wasn’t very flattering at all. (4) The sleeves. They are  really long, gather and “bloom” at the wrist. Awkward and my husband really didn’t like the sleeves. I mean, I was questioning them too. So why would you have a mock-neck, long sleeved shirt with short shorts?  To be honest, these design elements work separately but not together. I selected them and gave them the old college try. In conclusion, overall, I would only give these pajamas 2 stars and that is for the color. While from the photo all of these pajamas made it seem like it would work, they don’t. On me, they were ill fitting and not flattering at all.

title: A lovely necklace.
text: This necklace by Nenalia is unique and timeless. It is gold plated over sterling silver (925). It hangs mid chest. The round, heart-shaped pendant can be opened and inside is a white pearl shaped (i.e., round) stone. The stone is believed to make a slight sound (a chiming sound believed to call angels) if you shake it hard enough.  In the center of the pendant is a single clear stone. The chain is thick, sturdy, and easy to close. This necklace pairs well with any clothing and can be dressed up and down. In conclusion, this is a beautiful pendant although some may consider it a little pricey ($89). It’s worth it.

title: I ordered up but should have ordered my exact size.
text: You know how you can never tell how some things will fit when you order them on-line? You order up when you think they will be cut short or run small. For some reason, this is what I thought would be the case for this cardigan. I ordered up thinking that it would run small. I was wrong. It runs true to size. It was way too big in the shoulders and arms. However, if I could have worn it, it would have been lovely. I liked the striped (rust/burnt orange, tan, brown and black) pattern. The fabric was thin, so perfect for layering. It would be super cute with a t-shirt or mock-neck. It stopped a little above my knees (mid-thigh), but I’m short only 5’4. And finally, there are pockets, and everyone loves a good pocket. In conclusion, this is a great little cardigan with a lot of potential. Just order the right size.

title: Super cute casual or dressy dress!
text: This Charmyi dress is comfortable and affordable. It is a nice blue (dusty). There is ruching on the chest and a flattering waistline.  It is very slimming. The fabric, a blend of polyester and spandex, is very comfortable and breathable. There is a side zipper which is convenient. You can dress it up with jewelry or a nice jacket/cardigan. You can wear it with heels or sandals. And finally, it is affordable, under $30 on Amazon. I would recommend it.

title: Dainty and eye-catching.
text: These Goxtech earrings are pretty and fun. You have three stones (pink in color, different shapes) set inside a gold setting. They are lightweight and dangle. I didn’t notice any irritation or redness on my skin. They can be worn on a dressy occasion or at work. You can wear your hair up or down, up to you but up will make you a showstopper. They are just shiny enough to catch your eye and not be gaudy. I’d recommend them.

title: Stunning, pure crystal perfection.
text: This is a beautiful pendant by Crystal Art Project Store. The 18in, rhodium finished, gold-toned, silver chain holds a stunning 39mm (2in) Galactic (pale brown/amber) pendant. It is not perfectly shaped, so looks and feels very authentic and natural. It is a nice size, which stands out well against certain fabrics and colors. It definitely catches the light and the eye, which makes it a beautiful gift for yourself or someone else.

title: Retro. Circa 1950s.
text: This is a delightful dress by Aisize. The style is retro chic. The fabric is comfortable, a blend of polyester and spandex. The color is eggplant with a wide, black waistband, accented with a bow. It zips in the rear. I ordered up, which I am glad because it seems to run small. It is very slimming and flattering. You can add a jacket and wear it to the office. Overall, a decent dress at an affordable price.

title: Classy bling.
text: This Gemske Cuban chain (i.e., necklace) is nicer than I expected. When I ordered, I was worried that it would look cheap and gaudy. Fortunately, this necklace is the opposite. Not cheap or gaudy at all. You can pair this necklace with any clothing/outfit, and it will add just the right amount of sparkle. It feels heavy and substantial. There are tiny cz dust spread throughout the top of the chains, which adds just a little glitter or sparkle without being overwhelming. A nice accent feature. There is a simple slide-in clasp that secures it to your throat. This necklace is lead and nickel free, so no irritation to the skin on your neck. And finally, this is a fun necklace that I would recommend.

title: The joy of a great cardigan!
text: The Curlbiuty cardigan is fantastic. It is long, stops mid-thigh. It is black with a cable knit design. There is an open collar (no closure – i.e., zipper, buttons) with traditional thick material. It fits true to size. It is warm and cozy. It is well structured and great. I love it!

title: Polka dot delight. 3.5 stars
text: This Charmyi dress is super cute and practical. It is navy blue with large white polka dots. It is short-sleeved with a belt. The dress stops above the knee and has a hidden zipper. The fabric is soft and comfortable. It is a blend of polyester and spandex – very lightweight. It fits true to size. You can dress it up with a jacket or bolero sweater.

title: Worth a look.
text: The Realwe bracelet is unisex, meaning it will work for a woman or man. The links appear to be braided (wheat chain) and has a traditional clasp. It is 18k white gold-plated and did not irritate my skin. I noticed no redness or rashes (hypoallergenic). Overall, this is a decent bracelet that anyone would like.

title: An ill-fitting mess!
text: This dress by Honwenle was awful on me. Not flattering at all. The pattern (blue leopard) was pretty in photos but looked like a hodge-podge of designs when I received it. The colors – blue, black and white will appeal to some, but the fabric looks haphazard when you see it. The design is v-neck with a belt (faux wrap) but when closed, it was too high under the breast. Made me look pregnant. It was ill fitting and too big. I plan to return it.

title: Underwhelmed and disappointing.
text: This necklace by Muaiolaus was not what I expected. The depictions were pretty, but in person it looked a little cheap and haphazard. The chain is sterling silver, and the pendant has a heart-shaped iridescent stone. It is inscribed with “I love you forever,” outlined with small cz stones. The pendant is large, about the size of a nickel and quarter. This would probably look better on an older person than on a middle aged one. In conclusion, I was very underwhelmed and plan to return it.

title: A sassy little black dress. 4.5 stars
text: This is a simple, yet elegant black dress. Milreason has definitely designed a hit. It has a nice v design (neck and back) with an A-line skirt. There is a hidden zipper which makes it easier to get off and on. The fabric, a blend of polyester and spandex, is comfortable and breathable. You can wear it alone or with a jacket. To really highlight the outfit, add some nice jewelry and cute shoes!

title: I looked a mess! Very ill-fitting.
text: Ok, the thought of this Kfubuo dress was fantastic. In my mind, I saw myself wearing this for picnics or BBQs. Unfortunately, the thought didn’t meet the reality. This dress was very “ill-fitting” on me. I looked pregnant even after adjusting the straps! Ironically, I ordered up because I feared that the top would be too tight, especially considering the style. The dress is tri-colored (cream, army green and eggplant) and sleeveless. The material is thin and plain. To be honest, I looked awful. It was so bad that I didn’t want to keep it to even wear around the house or to be.  With that being said, I returned this dress and would not recommend it.

title: A timeless timepiece.
text: I collect three things: coats, watches, and purses. It doesn’t matter the cost. If I like the style and it catches my eye, I will pick it. This watch is no different and will be a welcomed piece to my collection. This Oupinke watch is GORGEOUS. This is my first green watch. The green face is square shaped. There is a date window located at the 6. The color is a nice, rich, emerald green – with gold accents (bezel and clasp). The band has a textured look which makes it fashionable.  It is well made and comfortable on the wrist. Overall, this is a beautiful watch that I think women of all ages will love. I’d definitely recommend it.

title: Cute, casual shirt!
text: This is a nice plaid (purple & blue), casual shirt. I like the mock neck and long sleeves. The fabric is soft and comfortable, but thin. You can dress it up with a jacket or wear it alone with some jeans. It is lightweight, made from stretchy material. It is perfect for fall weather.

title: Perfecto.
text: These are a simple pair of silver (925) hoops by Aoavov. They are small (about the size of a dime) but catch the eye due to the shape (fuller at the bottom). They are lightweight and have the standard closure. They did not irritate my skin or pull on my holes. They will match anything that you want to wear them with. And finally, they came in a cute, lace, drawstring bag that is perfect for gift giving. I’d highly recommend these.

title: Yummy Young. Yummy Fun.
text: I really like this light wool blend, hooded sweater/cardigan by YummyYoung. It is a nice oatmeal or wheat color. It is slightly woolly so very cozy and comfortable. There are no buttons or other closures. It doesn’t itch or bite. There is no need to order up. To me it seems to run a little big. I plan to wear it with slacks or jeans. It would also look great with leggings and boots. I really like it and plan to wear it often.

title: Runs small. Definitely order up.
text: This Genhoo double breasted, plaid jacket is super cute. The fabric (100% polyester) is slightly textured, reminds me a little of linen. The plaid design (black, white) is simple and will match both jeans or slacks.  My only real criticism is this jacket runs small. I highly suggest ordering up. While I can’t button my jacket, I plan to wear it open. In conclusion, I give the design 5 stars, but in terms of execution and fit, 2. This leaves me with an overall rating of 3.

title: Fantastical, fanciful, and whimsical.
text: This is a beautiful bracelet by Fanci. There are iridescent stones (Aurora Borealis crystals) that sparkle and pick up the colors you are wearing. I have never heard of AB crystals but appreciate them now that I have seen them. The stones are different shapes and sizes.  They glisten, twinkle and shine. It is adjustable. It can be worn casually or when you dress up. The packaging is nice, which makes it great for gift-giving. Most women will enjoy this piece of jewelry. I’d highly recommend it.

title: Square stud earrings.
text: These Fanci Kaleidoscope stud earrings are prettier than I expected. They are square shaped with silver posts. The packaging is nice and perfect for gift giving. The square crystals are clear and a tranquil blue. The backs are easy to secure. I’d recommend them.

title: A decent little dress.
text: This little dress by Lidlit is decent. It has long sleeves (so you don’t have to wear a jacket unless you want to). It is v-neck with ruching between the breasts. The skirt is flared, which is very flattering and forgiving (camouflages my stomach area). The fabric is a nice blend of cotton and polyester. There is a zipper and pockets. This dress stops at the knee. You can wear it with heels, flats, or sandals.

title: Lightweight and comfortable.
text:
These Genleck jeans are light blue with an asymmetrical button fly design.
They fit true to size or are a little baggy.
They are lightweight and comfortable.
They are super cute with tennis shoes.
I would probably wear them with shirts that cover the button fly design, which of course defeats the purpose of the design feature. But oh well.

title: It is super tiny.
text: I really like this necklace, but boy is it tiny. I can barely see the stones. You will need a magnifying glass to see the stones. It looks more like a tiny bar. It is very dainty and feminine.

title: A navy-blue military style coat.
text: I plan to rock this double-breasted jacket this fall/winter. It is smart and very professional looking. It is a rich, navy blue with gold military buttons.  The waist flares into a full skirt. The jacket stops mid-thigh. You can wear open or closed. And finally, be careful when ordering. It seems to run small, so definitely order up.

title: Very professional looking laptop tote!
text: This Cluci laptop bag is fashionable and very professional looking. I received it in black (with silver hardware). The sides are colorful and expand. You have two options for carrying: traditional handles or a shoulder strap.  There are pockets, inside and out. There is an area for pens, pencils, and cards (business or ID). There is even an area to house your computer. I have a Dell Inspiron and it fits nicely with plenty of room. You can put additional items inside like a calendar/agenda, a paperback/hardback book (or books), and other essentials.  The bag zips to hold your items securely.  I really like it.

title: Wife likes. Husband approved.
text: I got this Coai bracelet for my husband, and I am pleased. He isn’t into jewelry, except a wedding ring, but he likes that this bracelet is simple. It is well constructed and fashionable. It will match most outfits (casual to dressy) since it is just a subtle accent piece to an outfit. This bracelet is made of black onyx and seraphinite stone beads, which are strung through the middle and around the outside of each bead. The center or middle bead is seraphinite, dark green in color. At first glance this bead blends in, no big difference noted, but when the light hits it just right, you do notice a slight variance/a subtle design (in the green bead). Note: You can see it in the picture but in person, not so much. You can adjust it (to fit) by pulling the strings apart. The strings are accented by two smaller beads. It looks and feels substantial. There is some weight to it. Feels great on your wrist. This bracelet, while probably unisex, is masculine. Surprisingly, my husband really likes it. I’d recommend it.

title: Flirty and fun.
text: This cute sweater by Ymoshoe is great. It is a soft gray (called apricot) color. The sleeves are short and accented by ruffles. Very feminine and flattering. The crew neck and cable design (on the front) all complement each other. The nylon/polyester/viscose blend fabric is soft and doesn’t itch or irritate the skin. Overall, this is a cute top that you can wear with anything (i.e., jeans, skirts, or slacks).

title: Can be worn with any and everything!
text: The Newffr casual blazer is perfect for the office. It is a beautiful color, caramel/camel. Traditional style - one button, with pockets. It is lightweight and comfortable. It fits true to size, no need to order up. The fabric is a blend of polyester and spandex. This blazer can be worn with every and anything – from pants to jeans. I’d recommend it.

title: Thin, expensive/overpriced.
text: Cable & Gauge has created a dress with some potential. It is brown (Mocha Toffee), with a zipper closure (stops mid-chest), and hoodie. It stops mid-thigh. I ordered up because I didn't want it to be fitted. That was a good call because this dress tends to run small.  However, I am not sure why this dress retails for $58. It is thin (really thin) and light. The fabric (blend of polyester, spandex and rayon) feels great against the skin. Overall, the design of the dress is cute, but I don’t think it’s worth the retail price on Amazon.

title: Nice traditional jacket.
text: This is a nice traditional blazer with button. The color is a blue/green. It can be worn with slacks, jeans or a dress. It looks great with navy, gray and black. And finally, it fits as expected. I’d recommend it.

title: Cute, now I just need to use a little pandemic weight.
text: This Knitee dress is perfect for the holiday season. It’s sexy, flirty, and fun. It has a very nice design. The design will complement most body types. It is sleeveless, has a faux wrapped top, and a ruffled hem. It zips in the back and stops mid-thigh or just above the knee. The color is a rich burgundy, or wine. You can add some cute accessories like a large belt, a bolero cardigan or jacket – some fun jewelry and you are ready to go. The fabric is great, stretchy and forgiving, a blend of polyester and spandex. It is fitted, so keep that in mind. Mine will fit perfectly as soon as I lose some pandemic weight. You can wear this versatile dress for work or play.

title: A beautiful timepiece.
text:
This Lazoom watch is gorgeous.  
It is gold with a nice blue (with a hint of green) face.
 There are no numbers, only notches to denote the time (hours and minutes).
The bracelet is adjustable.
 It is German inspired and utilizes Japanese quartz movement.
 The packaging is simple - a sturdy cardboard box with a pillow.
 This watch is affordable, feminine and dainty.
 I highly recommend it.

title: WOW~
text:
This Lanzoom necklace is chic and fashionable.
 If I had to describe the pendant, I’d say it reminds me of a sunburst on one side and a solitary star on the other.
 Very simple.
Very classic.
Perfect for women of all ages.  
You can wear it with anything.
 Gold plated. Hypoallergenic. Non-irritating. Lead-free.
 Nice packaging. It came in a nice box, suspended in plastic.
I’d recommend it. 5 stars

title: A gorgeous bracelet that both men and women can enjoy!
text: This is a lovely bracelet by Coat. The azurite beads are colorful and lovely. They are blueish/green (kind of turquoise) and will match most outfits. The beads are accented by a single silver bead and silver claw closure. While this bracelet is marketed towards men, women can enjoy it (I know that I am).

title: I should have ordered up!
text: I don’t know why I thought this shirt would fit. Well it fits, but not like I traditionally like my t-shirt’s to fit. I definitely don’t like them to be fitted. I like mine to fit loosely. So, when I ordered this Goranbon shirt in an XL, I should have ordered up. It seems to be more of a fitted style. The style of fabric is waffle, but you can see through (thin) the material. So I would suggest wearing a tank or something underneath. And finally, what I do like is that the color is white and can be worn with anything - a skirt, shorts, jeans or khakis. So out of 5 stars, I would give it 3.

title: Not as plush as I had hoped!
text:
This sweatshirt is thin and the fabric not super soft, but decent. You can layer if needed.  
It is heather gray with black lettering (Brooklyn New York).  
The style is a traditional sweatshirt - crew neck.
 I prefer my sweatshirts to be baggy so I ordered up. Glad I did. It is a little oversized but runs a little small, in my opinion.
In conclusion, this is a mid level quality sweatshirt that isn’t the best quality but can be worn.

title: Can't wait until the season changes!
text: This crew neck pullover/sweatshirt is super comfy! The fabric (a polyester/cotton blend) is a pretty color, seafoam green.  It is soft and comfortable. I like that it has pockets. It fits true to size, so don’t order up. I did but like my sweats baggy. The only thing I am waiting on is the season to change so I can wear this while running errands.

title: Protect your ears!
text: An important accessory for any gun owner to use at the gun range, besides eye protection is ear protection. These headphones can also be used for working on other household projects. They are perfect for protecting your ears from loud noises. You will need two AAA batteries which are not included. There are two microphones and an audio input which includes the auxiliary cable. These are very comfortable over/on the ears and head. The volume, which is adjustable, is great when trying to listen to instructions without removing the headsets. I’d definitely recommend these.

title: A decent blouse~
text:
A simple maroon blouse.  
It has a v-neck (no real collar) and buttons down the front.  
The sleeves are long and have an elastic closure.  
There is a slight pattern throughout that will remind you of small puffs, which offers some texture.
 It fits true to size.  
This blouse looks great under suits, with slacks and even jeans.
I also like that you can wear it tucked inside your pants/skirt or outside.  
And finally, this blouse will look great with colors like navy, tan or gray.
 I’d recommend it.

title: A comfortable dress!
text: This Ann Darling dress is super cute. It is very lightweight and comfortable. The material is silky and feels great against your skin. Upon arrival it was very wrinkled (see photos) but after allowing it to hang in the bathroom while I took a shower (I could have also used a warm iron/steamer) and the wrinkles came right out. The colors are vibrant and bright. There are multiple shades of blue, some black, yellow and white. This dress has pockets. You can pair this with a cardigan or jacket, flats or sandals. It is short sleeved and stops above the knees. Overall, this is a nice dress that I think women of all ages will enjoy.

title: Perfect when you need something on your arms!
text: This is a beautiful lightweight cardigan by Lavidence. It is a traditional cardigan - front buttoned closure with pockets. The color is a soft heather grey. The fabric, a blend of viscose and nylon, is comfortable. This sweater is perfect to wear in a cool office or on a cool fall night. It fits true to size. I ordered up but didn’t need to. You can wear a shirt underneath or a tank. I’d recommend it.

title: Some support!!
text: This (Comfelie) seamless bra is better than I expected. As I said, there are no seams. You can remove the inside padding if you’d like. The fabric (a nylon/spandex blend) is soft, breathable and comfortable. The color is a nice coffee or warm beige. The (wide) straps are adjustable and it even comes with an extra extender. And finally while it is wireless, it does offer some support. You can wear it as an everyday bra or even work out in it.

title: Joyours is Joyous!!
text: The Joyours dress is very practical. It is black, so a neutral color.  It has a round collar and a layered skirt.  The sleeves are long, but don’t come to the wrist (so not really 3/4).  This dress seems to run a little large. I ordered up but didn't need to. You can layer (with a denim jacket or blazer) and wear with heels or sandals. Overall this is a great dress that I will wear often.

title: Doesn't look good on me! Beware!
text:
I loved the concept of this dress but am not sure I like the final product. I usually appreciate anything denim, so selecting this cute little number was a no brainer. Unfortunately, my expectations did not meet reality. And I will admit, it could be my body shape or my insecurities, regardless, I am not very fond of it.

The Apbondy denim dress is nice, but there are some issues at least in my opinion. The dress itself is a little short (stops mid-thigh), so wearing it as a dress (at my age – I’m middle aged) is definitely out of the question. I would have to wear it with leggings. The sleeves are long and wide, but there is an option to button it (making it shorter). However, when the sleeves are loose, they look weird. There is a v shape to the opening (nehru collar), and it buttons down the front, which is accented by pockets (on the breasts). There is also a large ruffle towards the bottom (hem). The fabric is dark blue and thin. It is oversized, so there is no need to order up. This also explains why I didn’t like the fit. It runs super big. And even when I tried to jazz it up, with leggings, earrings etc., there was still something a little frumpy about it. It also made me look larger than I am. So, I will be wearing this around the house only. 2 stars is being generous.

title: Gorgeous necklace!
text: The CDE Sunflower Coin Necklace is gorgeous. It is gold plated over 925 silver. The necklace/chain itself is a series of small links. Very trendy. The pendant is round, with small (cz) stones around the perimeter. The inside or middle of the pendant is a flower accented by more small (cz) stones. You can layer this necklace or wear alone. I am sensitive to some metals but I noticed absolutely no redness or irritation. Overall, I would recommend this necklace for yourself or someone else. It's gorgeous. 5 stars

title: Not a dress if you are tall
text: I'm 5'10" and a size 16/18. I got this in a size XL and it was just too small through the shoulders, really tight in the arms and too short to be used as a dress. That wasn't surprising though to me, I'm used to dresses running short, if it fit in other ways, I could have used it as a tunic. The fabric was just ok. A bit on the thin side and it almost fit more like a mock neck. The neckline wasn't as scooped as the picture shows on me. If you are short-average height, you could probably make it work as a dress, but on me it just barely covered my backside. Color matched the picture.

title: Love the fit of the dress

I’m returning the green though because the color is not quite like the picture, it isn’t as dark. Instead of it being a deep army green shade, mine was more of a lighter mossy color that really isn’t too pleasant, think of green with a touch of poo brown thrown in.

The amaranth red shade was much better, though still a bit off from the photo, had like a tint of mauve’y purple to it but I like it.

title: Alright, with a few cons
text:
I'm 5'10" and a size 16 (XL in tops typically, 16 jeans) 38C chest, and this fit me in a size XL. It came right down to the bottom of my knees. Overall this is an ok dress. I wouldn't spend more than about $20 tops on it though. I tried it on when I first got it and then washed it on cold in a mesh bag and hung it to dry to make sure it wouldn't shrink and then tried it on again and it was fine. There are a bunch of loose threads on it, I feel like the buttonholes could really use another round of stitching to make them feel sturdier but they're fine. The fabric hangs well and has some nice drape to it and it came out with just a few wrinkles when air drying. I would just need to toss it in the dryer for a few minutes to fix that.

I will say that if you have a larger than average chest, this probably won't fit you. The buttons on mine are strained, just toeing the line between being tight and starting to gap. I can get away with it but can easily see how the top would be an issue for anyone larger, and my chest isn't even that large for my frame at all, I feel like I'm on the smaller side actually. For the price I paid, I feel like its worth keeping though.

title: Not the Same, But They Work
text: These aren't the same material as the non-maternity Felina leggings. They aren't the butter material or the cotton material. They are thicker than both. The material is super soft, but it is also very thin. You can see completely through the pants when they’re held up to light. So, your pants might go invisible in direct sunlight. Inside, if you’re wearing appropriate colored under garments, they’re fine.

title: Sexy looking belt!
text:
Wow! What a good looking and sexy belt.. This is such a high quality- from the moment you open the package.. it gives off a smell of new leather and that’s a perk! (Some items can have a yuck chemical smell when arriving making you question what it’s really made of...lot, where. not this!!)
The thickness is perfect- it easily fits standard belt loop on pants or slacks.. Yet, its sturdy enough to lend its support, in keeping pants up/holding things in. The buckle is brushed silver and easy to maneuver.. we did need to add one extra hole for the perfect comfort while wearing- and with the leather being a soft and pliable quality.. we did this, no problem. The stitching is very precise as well as the cut edges (I think we’re all familiar with a cheap belt that begins to shed “string layers” on the outer cut edge of the belt...?) well, this is finished with quality 360’ of the item.
This was for an adult male: 6’4”, 205lb., 36x36
The belt size ordered was a 36... and that is the only issue seen… Only the last hole on the belt would fit comfortably on a male with a true 36” waist giving the reason for adding an additional hole! I realize as this belt wears and stretches- it may need to be tightened to a smaller hole.. and that would be no problem, there are plenty of options if you’re on the smaller end of the size 36 belt. My suggestion- if unsure or hesitant on sizing, you are best to size up!!
**i definitely want to add- this belt would be equally perfect for a female as well. I realize it is thicker width then, standard skinny women’s belts- but, If you prefer a thicker style.. this is a great option.
Overall, this is a classy looking belt. So, if looking for something that is quality constructed to last and looks good as it’s doing it- this is a great choice! Definitely can be used to dress up/down.

title: Lurex is a sparkly tinsel like thread!!!
text:
Ok- major error I guess on my part.. but, so others don’t make my same mistake- Lurex is a sparkly tinsel like thread that is sewn into the actual hat.. and I didn’t know or, expect it.
Bigger issue- this was intended for a teenage boy!! The actual hat it’s self is made quite nice which is also disappointing because, I’m looking for this exact tighter fitted KNIT style hat. A lot on the market seem to be Knitted- only end up loose fitting and bulky. Or, one can find a fitted knit hat but, it totally misses the mark as it resembles the look of a burglar or else, It’s made of fleece! Exactly what I’m trying to avoid and why my interest in this particular hat - This hat has a soft texture and seems like quality material and crafting- no loose threads, straight seams and really nice attention to detail. The best of all, it fits your head without the extra 1” of nothing left at the top.. or, the 3” roll of the outer brim- just to size it right. So, for anyone in need of a sparkly hat- this is a great choice!
One last thing to add.. the hat to me seems very seasonal or festive! Which could be nice as we are coming right into the holiday season... it’s definitely made for a female audience with a Christmas/new year’s vibe for sure! Not sure how but, I missed women’s in the description.. So be aware, not all hats are created equal!! I tend to think of a beanie hat as unisex... nope!

title: beware- far too long shoulder strap!!!
text:
I like the concept and size of the bag For a small purse, it’s especially nice when caring a regular style purse is not conducive to the activity. This has two separate pockets that are easily accessible and the bag fits everything a small purse would. Problem is, the straps on the back are far from workable!! These “streamers” are way too distracting and keep me from loving the bag..

What am I talking about or referring too..???
Issue: these adjustable Straps obviously have to have excess length to accommodate the different size users- But, these hang beyond too long once you adjust the length to an appropriate and proper shoulder length and I’m referring to the adjustments to fit an adult- on a small child, this issue would be worse!.. it’s like two long “tails” hanging down off each shoulder! Conundrum: when it arrives- each strap has been nicely sewn and finished so, they won’t fray or, run. Yet, if you were to cut off the excess strap .. and by excess, after an adult 5’7” adjusts the backpack to fit loosely on her shoulders- there are approx. 10” of excess strap on each side hanging down ... if I cut these, the ends will unravel- most likely causing more of an unsavory look to the bag.

The material feels durable and the construction in other places seems quite adequate… Zipper is easily open/closed- and has small flap to cover keeping it from getting snagged.
