title: Attractive single-layer polyester kids’ Christmas masks with adjustable ear straps
text: There are five attractive Christmas masks in this set. They are single layer polyester. There is no nose wire  but the ear loops are adjustable with a circular silicone adjuster on each loop. If pulled too much, these adjusters can fall off but that is not too easy to do. There is no nose wire but none is needed because these masks mold to the face. These can be worn over other masks or alone. I think these are nice and they are washable. Nevertheless, one can wear two of these at once to double the protection. The current price of $8.99 comes to $1.80 per mask which is reasonable.

title: Roomy but fitted & soft mask w/nose wire & 10 filters; a bit pricey
text: One large adult-sized mask comes in this package along with some full-faced filters I have never seen before. The mask is made of a soft cotton, is somewhat form fitting, and has pockets on the inside for the filter. The ear elastics are comfortable and there is a nose wire in the top for a securer fit. With the filter this mask is 4-ply from what I can tell. The filter is 2-ply and the mask is also 2-ply. I actually love this set but the current price of $14 for one cotton mask with 10 filters is a bit pricey. My local big box store sells 10 black masks like these for $12.99 (no filters).

title: Runs small & also too short for a tank top; very soft and stretchy
text: I ordered what was supposed to be a tank for my very skinny friend. However, she can't fit in this. First of all, this is not a tank top. Tank tops fall below the belly button and this one comes above. Second, it runs on the small side. It includes a padded bra and the fabric is super soft. I do not feel this would be supportive enough for running but for light workouts it would be great. The problem is the short style. I can see this is more for a teenager. I also feel the current price of $29.99 is too expensive for this.

title: Lightweight, gorgeous frames; very comfortable glasses w/one case
text:
These reading glasses are very attractive and colorful. In the box are two pairs, one case, and one cleaning cloth. My case arrived with a small stain I cannot get rid of; it actually looks like a water stain.

The glass frames are lightweight and open and close easily. There are no spring hinges but I do not feel that is needed. In place of nose pads are the hard plastic of the frame but due to the lightness of the frame, it does not make them uncomfortable to wear.

These work well for reading. I do not notice any anti-glare ability or "blue-light" blocking ability as claimed but that is not why I ordered them.

The current price of $16.19 ($17.99 minus 10%) is competitive for this set. The lightness of the frames are this set's best feature.

title: Nice hoodie but arrives super wrinkled and is 100% Polyester; it's true to size
text:
This is an attractive red, white, and blue hoodie. Had I known it was 100% polyester, I would not have ordered it. However, it fits well, has two large pockets at the waistline, and a drawstring hood. It did arrive extremely shrink wrapped, so it came out of the bag incredibly wrinkled.

I ordered an XXL and should have ordered an XL because it is true to size. Someone said it ran small and that is just not so. An XL would have been loose on me and this XXL is swimming on me.

This can only be washed on the wool setting and needs to be air dried.

title: Compression in all the right places; helps with my plantar fasciitis
text:
I have plantar fasciitis and have been trying and using various compression socks and sleeves and arch inserts to help reduce the pain and prevent a recurrence once the pain is gone. These socks are not only stylish, but they feel great on and actually have compression in the arch area where the purple arch line is shown in my photo. There is also good compression in the calf area.

I ordered the small/medium even though I would take a large/extra-large based on their sizing (I take a 9 to 9.5 shoe). I find that these are a bit long as I have to roll the top over to prevent it from coming above my knee. They fit me perfectly, otherwise.

I wore these all day and felt great wearing them. I also love the styles they come in. These are not only "fun" but they are medically helpful for my plantar fasciitis. I wash socks like these in a lingerie bag and lay them flat to dry.

Currently, there is no price listed on Amazon for these socks but I would expect them to be priced in the $12.99 to $16.99 range.

title: Compression in all the right places; helps with my plantar fasciitis; runs large
text:

However, since they are on the large side, I'm passing them off to my boyfriend. I have several pairs of these socks and have worn their socks all day. It feels great wearing them. I also love the styles they come in.

These are not only "fun" but they are medically helpful for my plantar fasciitis. I wash socks like these in a lingerie bag and lay them flat to dry. Currently, there is no price listed on Amazon for these socks but I would expect them to be priced in the $12.99 to $16.99 range. The only reason I lowered my rating one star is because they are larger than the size specified; otherwise, these are 5-star socks in my opinion.

title: Right arm on each frame will not open all the way; marginal quality but attractive

In my opinion,  the current price of $15.59 comes to $5.20 per pair which I feel is too expensive due to the marginal quality.

title: Pretty pattern but mask is too large and does not cinch tight to my face
text: There is one dog design mask with adjustable ear elastics & a filter pocket in this package along with a matching bandana. The silicone adjusters on the ear elastics will fall off if adjusted out too far. There is also a nose wire that allows me to mold this to my face. However, after all the adjustments, I find these are still a bit roomy around my upper cheeks  and my chin area. Although the bandana is nice, it is nothing I will use.  The current price of $9.95 is on the high side of the competitively priced for this duo. If the mask was not so loose, it would have received 5 stars from me simply because I really love the design.

title: Attractive bracelet; I see no health benefits; jewelry only; link adjuster included; no instructions
text:
This is a very attractive stainless steel bracelet in an electric blue. It is designed for men but it works well for women as long as the links are adjusted. It is adjustable in the sense that links can be removed with the link adjuster. That is not an easy task but there are online videos to assist, There are NO instructions provided instructions in the box. The magnets are on the underside of the bracelet in every link.

The magnets are supposed to confer health benefits such as pain relief, arthritis relief, body balancing, improve blood pressure, etc. I do not subscribe to such hocus pocus and, after having worn bracelets like this previously and tried this one, I have experienced no health benefit. However, wearing a piece of jewelry that is attractive is certainly mood enhancing. The current price of $18.99 is excellent for this. The only reason I rated this 3 stars is because of the health benefit claims that I do not see; otherwise it is a 5-star bracelet at a good price. If some health benefits are achieved for a select few individuals, then I consider that a bonus. It is definitely a recommended buy as jewelry.

NOTE: Anyone with a pacemaker should not wear magnetic bracelets.

title: Form fitting child's mask with adjustable ear straps & filter pocket
text: This mask is very nice for a young child. It is 3-ply and has an interior filter pocket. There is NO nose wire on this; it is form fitting for a secure fit, a tiny bit stretchy, and made of a soft material for comfort. The ear elastics are adjustable but the silicone adjuster on the end will fall off if it's adjusted too far and they are impossible to get back on. Nevertheless, this is a good mask but the current price of $12.99 is pricey for this.

title: Form-fitting 2-ply masks except loose in the chin area
text:
There are three black masks with the HS company logo in this package and all of them fit well but are loose in the chin area.

None of the masks have a filter pocket or bendable nose wire. They also do not have adjustable ear elastics.

The masks almost fit me perfectly if it were not for the loose chin area. These are still usable but are not yet perfect. If they were from fitting all over, this would have received 4.5 stars from me. I personally do not like having a company logo on a mask.

In summary, these are not my favorite masks since they do not mold to my face but they are still functional. The current price of $29.99 comes to $10 per mask which is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Six pairs in 5 colors; not much compression and a bit thin
text:
These are more like standard ankle socks than anything else. They are also a bit thin and are not cushioned in the heel. They do fit well (I have large feet in size 9-10) but the compression is super mild.

These are okay but not great. The six pairs in the package come in the following designs:

- 2 white w/teal heel
- 1 white w/yellow heel
- 1 white w/red heel
- 1 white w/purple heel
- 1 black with teal trim

The current price of $12.59 ($13.99 minus 10%) comes to $2.10 per pair.

text:
I took a chance when I ordered this hoodie because the title said it was a full zip--meaning a jacket and not a pullover as pictured. However, I figured it was as pictured and I am correct. I did ask Amazon to make the adjustment to the title to reflect the picture.

This hoodie is soft, warm, and plush. I have no idea how it will hold up to washing as I have not laundered it yet. The arms are a bit long and it is loose on me because I ordered a 2XL since an XL was not available but I consider it true to size.

Overall, I am pleased with my purchase so far and will update my review if anything changes after laundering. The current price of $44.99, which is what I paid for it, is pricey but is still about the going rate for hoodies these days.

title: Hydrating duo; hint of lavender; thick cream that takes a while to absorb

Unfortunately, there is no current price listed for this.

title: Just get the right size and it's perfect
text:

title: Floral tank dress with pockets
text:

Love love love. And I rarely get to say that about clothes of any kind.
UPDATE: 10/3 ... I've gone back to order 2 other prints. They wash beautifully. Wear so comfortably. The pockets are the key. Would love if they would come up with a sleeved version!

title: Exceptionally well organized and Vegan-Friendly
text:
I own a number of Booq products, so when I was offered a review sample of this new model I accepted. Like all Booq bags the emphasis is on efficient management of space as well as protecting electronics. This bag is no exception.

First, unlike the other bags that I own this one is kind of complicated, In fact, the shoulder strap and stabilizer strap design drove me crazy at first. Even the instruction card was of little help. Basically I had problems grasping how the magnetic buckle and stabilizing straps were designed for, as well as the fact that the shoulder pad on the strap hid the magnetic buckle when I first unboxed it. I finally figured it out with patience and carefully studying the diagrams.

Second, at first I thought the shoulder and stabilizer straps were poorly designed. I was wrong. They are designed for perfect ergonomics and balance. Again, this is a learning curve issue. In some ways Booq has been too clever in the design because there is a complexity that takes time to learn. For me it's worth it because I can carry a relatively heavy load (about thirty pounds) in a balanced fashion and still be assured that the tablet and a few other electronic odds and ends I carry are well protected. Protection is one area where Booq excels.

This is not trendy fine leather. Vegans will love it, and while I do not know exactly what it is, it's some sort of durable plastic material that is superbly constructed. The stitching, webbing, clasps and zippers are all first rate. Water literally rolls off it, and the reflective piping is a nice touch with respect to safety, whether walking or cycling.

Organizational options and features are another Booq hallmark. Instead of my trying to describe them in detail, look at the product photos on this page. There is a place for everything, and it has been well thought out. I've had this bag for a week and am still discovering compartments.

Bottom line: this is a bag that does take time to learn. It probably should come with a video or a link to one, which will make it immediately useful because I can assure you that the first day of ownership will be frustrating. Take your time and learn it because after that you will love it totally.

title: Well designed, but one minor issue
text:
I received this as a free review sample. Since there are a lot of reviews that describe this in minute detail I'll spare you another recitation. I am going to focus on a few things that slipped past other reviewers.

First, the reason for the four stars is the top zipper for the mouth of the bag is not as well made as the rest of the bag. To me it's the weak link in an otherwise superior product. There was a metal stop on mine that actually slipped off, but I was easily able to reinsert it, crimp it with a pair of pliers and all was well. Since this bag appears to be designed to remain open like a book bag I view this is a minor problem, but am compelled to point it out.

One other minor issue is the 'handles' should be a little longer of you plan to carry this by hand in lieu of using the shoulder strap.

On the plus side, the rest of the construction is first rate. I had a seamstress friend look it over and she said that the stitching was both straight and evenly spaced, both signs of high quality manufacturing. Others have amply described the material, color and liner, so I will just sat that I agree that those are nicely done as well.

To me this is best suited as a book bag. I was able to fit my gigantic [[ASIN:B00HWMPRKC Samsung Galaxy Tab Pro 12.2]] tablet in the main part of the bag with room left over for a slim 3-ring binder and some sheet music. There are other inner pockets on both sides of the liner that help keep things organized if used as a handbag or purse.

The outer pocket ironically has a nicely made zipper. It was slightly frustrating that it was an eighth of an inch too short to accommodate my 6 inch Galaxy Note 3 phone. If the design is changed to allow that pocket to store the larger phones like mine, the iPhone 6+ and Samsung Mega this would be a perfect bag for folks on the go who want a convenient bag for their electronics. In fact, this would be the perfect large format tablet and phone bag with a slight modification.

title: Promotes safety - generous sizing too
text:
I received this set as a free review sample. The human vest is in two pieces and once properly sized and configured should work for most folks unless you are extremely large (approaching 250+pounds). It took me about twenty minutes to figure it out and get it properly adjusted.

The canine vest is more like a lightweight cover that attaches under-belly via Velcro. The large will definitely accommodate a grown Lab.

Construction is very good. I had some concerns about the mesh or net portions of the vest, but it will hold up to machine washings, and if you are caught in the rain it quickly dries. The velcro on both is high quality and definitely catches and sticks. Most importantly, the reflective strips do an excellent job and can easily be seen in low beam headlights at least 20 meters (and probably more) away.

This is well thought out and well made. I don't know what the statistics are for folks getting hit while walking their dogs, but I cannot help but think that this set promotes safety.

title: Very light and soft.
text: The size allows this to be used either as a scarf, or a light wrap.  Nice, true blue stripes.  Great for evenings that turn cool.  Wonderfully soft and light.

title: Great during beauty treatments!
text: The fabric in this turban headband is a bit surprising - being a very lightweight knit.  But the second surprise is how comfortable it is when you’re wearing it! It’s perfect to hold your hair back during cleansing or giving yourself a facial.  I haven’t gone to the store in it yet - I’m using it so much for facial cleaning and moisturizing, that it is taking a permanent place in the bathroom!  Very pleased with this headband!

title: Protects the face when the sun is high!
text: This is a great hat - very floppy and easy to travel with - scrunch it up in the suitcase, and it just pops back in shape.  I prefer it without the bow - the black rim is enough trim.  It’s best when the sun is high and you’re getting it from all sides, as this hat protects the face really well.  We’ll be working out in our lavender fields in a couple months, and this will be the hat of choice.  Important to have a wardrobe of hats for all occasions.

title: Cool and flirty!
text: What do you wear for the BBQ when the weather’s hot?  A nice, loose, comfortable jumpsuit like this one.  Very cool fabric, lots of flowy , flirty pants legs - just very comfortable and cool!  The polka dots are small - white on navy blue - very perky and attractive. Can be dressed up or down with jewelry - a great alternative for your wardrobe!

title: Good colors, non-slip - perfect!
text: Nobody likes their socks to show these days, so these really fill the bill.  They’re also really good at staying on - no blisters with these socks.  Like the range of colors, too.

title: Comfortable to wear!
text: This was a “borrow” that turned into a gift!  Showing this to a daughter who tried it on, it became apparent that the fit was perfect and that it was just the thing for backyard BBQs and other parties.  So, because it looked better on her than on me, it is hers!  She reports that it is a hit whenever she wears it - comfortable and easy to wash and dry.  It is rare that Grandma has anything a daughter wants - so we can say that this is a multi-generational success!

title: Great for reading - wherever!
text: I love to read outside, so sunglasses plus reading glasses are necessary.  It’s been difficult to find that combination in 3.0, but here they are.  They’re lightweight and let the breezes blow through - and make outside reading a pleasure.  Great for the beach!  The style is good, too - I get compliments!

title: Just because it’s winter...
text: Just because it’s winter, cold and snowy, everybody doesn’t have to dress like a skier. Lots of ski hats around, but not many stylish but warm ones available.  This looks cute on everyone and keeps the head warm, too,

title: Disappointing..
text: The opals looked fine, but the gold-plated stud looked very cheap.  I wore them once, and my earlobes didn’t like them, which made me wonder if they really were gold-plated.  I can wear gold only - everything else infects my earlobes, so these have been put aside.  I wish the settings looked like quality, as the opals look good.

title: Very pretty!
text: Great gift idea for the graduate - or for holiday gifting.  This looks like real quality - will get a lot of attention and raves because it is so different.  Looks like a fine jewel pendant - should be a good gift for young adults through seniors.

title: Comfortable!
text: My grandson tells me that these are cool and comfortable.  We know that they wash and dry easily with no shrinkage.  The price was good for a five pack.

title: Bamboo sunglasses?  Wow!
text: I ordered these out of curiosity, but after seeing and feeling them, they may be my favorites!  They’re very light-weight, which is a real kindness to my nose - and they’re also just the right amount of tint.  They look great, too - and folks don’t realize that they’re “wood” until you tell them!  The more I wear them, the more I like them - they’re well-made and come in a great little box - which make them great for gifting!  Very happy with my bamboo glasses!

title: A perfect gift!
text: These are beautiful earrings - they gleam and glitter when they catch the light, are very swingy, and garner lots of attention.  The  green stone looks like a huge, fine emerald and the gold-plated earring itself looks like find quality.  Anyone who loves to get dressed up will love these!  Perfect gift for a granddaughter!

title: Nice, strong umbrella...
text: We have the base, so were able to set this up right away.  Unfortunately, we’ve had so much wind lately that we’ve had to store it in a safe place, as the wind damaged our previous umbrella beyond repair.  However, we know that this operates smoothly and the lights work great, so we’re all set for a warm, sunny day with a gentle breeze!  Great umbrella.

title: Cute little “black dress”
text: This is perfect for my granddaughter who works in marketing and goes to company parties for clients all the time.  She looks great in it, as the tie-front detail gives her curves where none exist!  Easy care polyester and added spandex for comfort.  The lower hem gives it a more professional look for those parties.  Good choice!

title: Great for the beach
text: My granddaughter reports that this is her favorite bikini - very comfortable, fits great and looks great, too. She doesn’t like string ties, so this gives her the kind of assurance she wants when wearing it.  Looks great with cover-ups - she wears a sarong skirt with the top and looks fantastic.  Very happy with this swimsuit!

title: Nice and comfy!
text: Wear it off one shoulder or not - nice, wide neckline, perfect for jewelry.  Waffle-knit give it interesting texture for a casual sweater.  Great basic, black sweater that goes with everything - looks great with jeans.  Good choice!

title: They’ve thought of everything...
text: Great-looking leather wallet that has a place for everything...plenty of room for cards, cash, change, etc.  one thoughtful touch - the clasp has two settings - one for a slim wallet and one when it’s packed!  Good choice!

title: Not just for men!
text: Hard to find a lightweight sweatshirt for women - but here’s one that is equivalent to a women’s XL and fits very comfortably.  Perfect for around the fire on cool summer nights.  The French terry washes and dries great, and keeps it’s shape.  Good choice.

title: Good for yoga..
text: Racer-back good for flexibility - this may be wool, but is very lightweight and keeps its shape a lot better than cotton.  Washes and dries well - looks good with jeans, too.  Very comfortable.  Good choice.

title: Soft and comfortable!
text: Nice and roomy - very soft and “slouchy” - great for lounging.  The colors are a little different, but the top looks good with beige pants.  It’s the kind of top you can spend all day in - it’ll look great and you’ll be super comfortable!  Probably an all-year-around top, too - swingy and cool in the summer, and great under a sweater in the winter.  Good choice!

title: Showy cocktail ring
text: Perfect for those who love gold jewelry and like to wear multiple rings.  This ring does make a statement - it’s an unusual design, and will get attention and comments.  It fits a number of different fingers.  Great for those special occasions.  Good choice!

title: A necessity for fall/winter...
text: We sit around the firepit a lot in the fall  and this poncho will be the perfect warmth for that.  Good coverage, as it is ample size.  The gray and black will look good over most everything.  Very pleased with this nice, warm poncho!  It’s well made and a cozy wrap.

title: Great glasses!
text: Great for reading everything on the computer - they block the glare and function just like regular reading glasses.  The price is right, too, for these well-made glasses.  They’re  comfortable to wear.  Fairly lightweight - they’re great for recreational reading as well.  Good choice!

title: Great set!
text: The beanie and gloves are great!  We particular love the neck warmer that can be pulled up to be a mask when needed.  The yarn is very soft, and washes and dries easily.  We used the dryer on low.  The set is well-made and looks good on.  Nice and warm, as well.  Good choice!

title: Quality Y-shirt
text: Looks great on - with jeans or with dress pants under a blazer.  My grandson likes the pockets - great when he’s working in the garden.  This shirt really washes and dries well - no shrinkage.  Very soft and comfortable to wear.  Good choice.

title: Really cute!
text: Sherpa is thick enough to keep you nice and warm!  Zips up for a good fit and high collar.  Easy care - washable.  Looks cute with jeans and leggings. Perfect gift for teenagers on up.  Great choice!

title: The perfect sunglasses?
text: Always looking for the perfect style and the comfortable fit - and I think I’ve found it!  Yes, the style is retro, but it really all depends on the shape and my face, doesn’t it!  I really like them, and I get compliments, so these glasses are a great choice!

title: Very cute!
text: Very cute and comfortable, too.  Nice, soft fabric for good sleeping.  Easy care washing and drying - and no shrinkage.  Perfect for spring and summer.  Good choice!

title: My new favorite jammies
text: In the summer I always switch to shorts.  I love these because they are baggy, soft and keep me nice and cool when I sleep.  Love the tie dye pattern and the color too.  Highly recommend these!

title: My new favorite!
text: These are my new favorite sunglasses and I don’t think they are nerdy at all!  Love the polarized lens and the simple design and look.  I am getting lots of compliments on these too!

title: Very shiny!
text: Gold chainlink dangling earrings are just the right size - large enough to give your outfit some pizazz, yet not as overpowering as many hoops.  Especially shiny and as they dangle, the shine increases.  For those who love gold jewelry, these are an essential addition to their collections.  Easy to put on - and secure.  These would make a great gift, too!

title: Not comfortable
text: Billed as walking shoes, these sneakers are not comfortable for the long haul.  They don’t appear to have any arch support - just flat shoes with some foam.  They’re cute - but folks like us are looking for comfort, and some support - so these don’t work for us.

title: Nice for a gift
text: Sterling silver, which is very shiny - and lightweight at the same time.  Comfortable to wear with most anything, casual or more formal.  Good choice!

title: Very sparkley!
text: A little smaller than we expected, but they are well-made and are really good for an everyday earring.  Not too much bling - just right.  They look like quality and the sterling silver is kind to the ears.  Good choice.

title: This is a favorite!
text: This  is a great tote and it took only a few minutes to decide to transfer everything out of the old purse into this!  Nice for fall - it holds a lot and opens widely, so things are easy to find.  Very lightweight for a large tote - and that’s a plus, too.  Good choice!  Looks great, too!  Goes with everything.

title: Nice Jacket!
text: I ordered this as a gift for my daughter in law.  She has an edgy style and this jacket is perfect.  The fit is accurate by size and fits snuggly to the body.  Its warm too with the hoody/sweatshirt material underneath.  This is a good one!

title: Not as expected
text: This shirt just doesn’t match the pictures - which show it as a fairly sturdy fabric - and the different color hoodie also came as a surprise.  Overall, it looked a bit cheap, and was not what I hoped it would be.  For those who wanted something really lightweight, I guess they would be satisfied - but we were disappointed.

title: Versatile!
text: This is a spring or fall staple, when the weather is warm - and a winter staple, worn with a shirt underneath.  It looks great worn alone - it’s an attractive knit sweater vest.  With a shirt, it could go to work and look professional.  Nice fit and length - it’s medium weight.  Don’t see these nice vests very often - let's hope they are making a comeback!

title: Cutest little beach hat ever
text: This little beach hat is just too cute. Can't you just picture your baby's little head under this? This has upf 50 protection to keep your little one from getting sunburned. It is lightweight. It has a chin strap and sits out from and above the eyes so that baby's gets maximum protection. It is made of 83% nylon and 17% spandex. This only needs to be rinsed afterwards and hang dried. It is not recommended for machine wash and should never be cleaned with bleach. You also do not dry on wire hangers or leave in the sun to dry.

title: very cute velvet tee
text: This is such a cute blouse. The girl is going to love that it is velvet. And it is lightweight velvet at that. This is made of 92% Polyester, 8% Spandex, which gives it that light, velvety knit feeling. To wash this, it will need to be handwash in cold water and lay flat to dry. This is not one of those materials that you want to just toss in the washer with other clothes. It is uber cute and the girl will be so happy.

title: Comfy lightweight and multiple ways to wear
text: Clever, fashionable and transforming for different ways to wear. This pretty fringed plaid blanket wrap is great and one size will fit many different sized women. There are no armholes. You have a neckline that leads to an open front. You can wear it with a belt, as a wrap or however you want to manipulate for your personal preference. This is made of 100% acrylic, which can be machine washed in a cold, gentle cycle and then you can hang to dry. You can use a cool iron if you need to. This wrap is a lightweight material, so it works perfectly for early mornings and evenings, when the temperature is lower than during the day. It goes with so many solids, Looks great with jeans and a tee.

title: Beautiful wrap
text: The Orchid Row Reversible satin and chiffon wrap is perfect for an evening to dress up your outfit. The satin side is shiny and the chiffon side is matte. It is long and it is generous in the amount of fabric used. This is a one size and smaller women may find that it swallows them up. You can style the wrap as you would a scarf. It has many options on how you choose to wear the wrap. For me, it is great over my shoulders. The wrap is made of 100% polyester and can be machine washed, hang to dry and then use a low iron.

title: beautiful collar that will dress up any formal evening
text: This faux fur collar is going to look great against a bright or dark dress. It is a touch of glamour that you don't expect. The collar has 2 sets of rhinestone embellishments on each side to add an extra touch of glitz. It has a hook and eye closure, which is sturdy and not like the ones that come on bras. The collar is notched around the shoulder areas, so that it will fall perfectly in the front. Because of the material and embellishments, this is a dry clean only collar. It is so elegant, you will be waiting for some dress up event so you can wear this collar.

title: Can't say I care for this bra construction or look
text: This bra is okay, but there are things I do not like about it. I don't like how the support wires seem to be in the wrong location. I also don't like how it show without the straps. The front seems to dip down enough to look as if it is going to fall down. If you look at the picture without straps, you will see what I am talking about. In fact, the light woman seems like it is not a big enough cup to cover her goods. I don't like how the sides have two different pieces of elastic that separates in the middle, so it has the potential to be a big oops. Looking at the models they used for the bras, it doesn't look like either have been well fitted to the women, especially the one on the bottom. I could be wrong about how it seems to me, but I have stretched, pulled and placed over front and it is not a full coverage bra to me. I would say it is almost a balconette from the looks of where the top of the cup sits

title: Nice, gauzy, romantic off shoulder top
text: This is such a gauzy looking top with the off shoulder ruffle. It has long bell sleeves. The sleeves have a ruffle also and it is flowy, not heat holding. The shoulder and neck area are elasticized to keep it where it belongs. This is a perfect summer blouse that you can pair with shorts or jeans. You can dress it up some or be very casual. It is machine washable in cold water, line dry and then a low heat iron for touch ups. This reminds me of a romantic top.

title: I like the blouse but I don't like the clothing care and I am seeing too much of this type of care for clothes primarily teens
text: This is a super cute blouse. It has the round neckline, a button in the back, ruffled hem and a ruffle on the sleeves. This is for younger people. The girl will probably not be able to wear this to school, due to how the blouse rises when you lift your arms. I love the checkered look and I love the laciness between the top and ruffle. Here is what I don't like and I see it in too many clothing articles. This is made of 100% viscose. You can wash it in a washing machine, but you can't use softeners or a dryer. And you can't lay it on itself. That very statement puzzles me and you tell me if a teen is going to follow these directions,

title: Lovely bra, with a push up that makes you look great
text: This is an absolutely fabulous bra. It does have some padding to push up the girls but that isn't a bad thing. The front has a lovely piece of lace between the cups that looks like a wedge. The black straps have metal adjusters and they are attached to the back closure area atop a nice laced band that is atop a white and gold band with the hook and eye closures. This is such a pretty bra and it is so feminine.

title: Two thumbs up for the mittens from the girls
text: From the girls perspective, big and younger, they love these mittens. One has a blouse that matches. Another has a cap that matches. I don't know how they are going to work out who gets to wear them when it gets chilly in Florida. Our luck, it won't get cold enough to wear them but I can guarantee you that one of them will wear them. Especially the girl in middle school. They both love the print, the furriness and how they look on their hands.

title: Nice knitted scarf for all women
text: The scarf is knitted and has texture to it that you don't see in all scarves. It is easy to wrap this around your neck and it will look great with anything. There are no hanging tassels to get caught in anything. You could probably wrap it a couple of times for extra warmth.

title: Not a One Size
text: This is supposed to be a one size fits all swimsuit sarong/wrap. It isn't. Mine came marked as a Medium. And trust me, it was a medium or smaller. I am very disappointed. I was expecting a sheer sarong that I could wear. I also do not the fact that it has to be dry cleaned.

title: Looking forward to burning the fat
text: What I like about this belt, is that it not only helps you sweat to get rid of excess water in your belly area, but it also helps you have a straighter back - so it improves your posture. Not only that, it helps with some of your back pain. If I have something that works to do so many things, I am a happy camper.

title: Runs small so get a size larger
text: Cute racerback sports bra with a scoop neck. The pads are removable. The material wicks moisture to keep it dry and you drier and cooler. It is pull on and off. It is a nice material that looks waffled in some areas, so it looks like it has a bit more texture than a sports bra of spandex or similar material.

title: I believe I have found my favorite leggings
text: These leggings are different than others. First, you get compression. Second, they are capri length, Third is the see through leg and fourth is the leather look after the see through. You get support for your belly and you get strategically placed seams that help to enhance your figure.

title: Nice beach cover up
text: This cover up is a wonderful skirt for walking on the beach or even going to a party. I like the colors. I like how I can run the belt on either side through the loop on either side and it keeps it together when you tie them in a bow. The look is Bohemian and it is nice. With it being 100% cotton, follow all washing instructions carefully. You will most likely be doing some ironing with this, but it is worth the effort.

title: Runs small and no UV protection
text: When you are wearing a top like this to protect against rashes, you generally want to also have that garment provide UV protection. This only protects against rash. And it is smaller than you would expect, which restricts your movements.

title: Cute long sleeved rash guard tankini
text: This tankini is cute and very needed if you snorkel, paddle or go in any water that might have a rough bottom. Ideal for surfers. This has sun protection, rash guard and is quick dry. As with all swimwear, rinse after wearing, let dry and when you get home, hand wash in gentle detergent and hang to dry. This will keep your swimsuit looking best.

title: Definitely trendy club wear
text: If you live in the big cities, then you know clubbing is always in style. And when you go clubbing, you dress like a sexy beast. This dress allows you to do just that. This is a bondage dress made of scuba gear type material. It is revealing and you may need to get some tape to keep areas where they belong. But I love the zipper. You can zip up some leg if you want. This trendy for the past couple of years so you will be on point

title: lovely bra
text: This is a beautiful bra. With the bright red lace and the front gold closure, it is sexy and pretty. The straps are adjustable. They have thin padded cups. The look is different from others. The deep V plunge to the closure is sexy. The cups are underwire and the underwire helps shape you. The lace is unique in how it runs up over both cups.

title: Don't be afraid of the ribbed fabric
text: These are nice and soft panties. The ribbing is there but it isn't overbearing in the touch department. These are made of 96% modal and 4% spandex. The spandex gives you just enough stretch. The modal is what makes them so soft. These will have to be machine washed and you can tumble dry on low.

title: This looks so cute on the website
text: In person, it just isn't that great. It is also very small looking. It does not look like this is a quality item. I don't really know if this would fit a small, and I have a large. It reminds me of a christening dress. Perhaps it will look better on than off, but I don't know if anyone I know is this slim. This is really small

title: I love this Ruana with pearls
text: This is so cute. I love this Ruana and the pearls really send it up to another level. Anyone can wear this. It is easy to wear and has an open front. I just love it. I am fine with the grey color too. Grey is one of those shades you either love or dislike. I don't own much of anything that is grey. I do own this beautiful Ruana. Because of the embelishments and material, it is a hand wash and hang to dry.

title: Pretty holiday dress
text: This is a very pretty dress. It is golden. It has a nice drape to it. The waist is elastic and it also has a tie belt. The only issue is the front neck. It is a deep V and it has to be tied well at the top. You may want to use some clothing tape or sew in snaps or hook and eyes on the inside to make sure you don't fall out. Other than that, it is a lovely dress.

title: A skirt like no other
text: This skirt has material that has been sewn in such a way that it gives it a puckered look all around. The inside has a lining. The band looks like a crocheted elastic band. It is a very unusual and will probably a trending skirt. The balloon effect comes from the many sewn areas in the skirt that gives it a poofy look.

title: Nice cycling shirt
text: This cycling shirt has lots of cooling and it has the pockets in the back for your supplies and water. The material is self wicking and keeps moisture away. The only thing I am not impressed with, is that the stripes at the zipper, do not line up like they should.

title: Long jammies
text: These pajama bottoms have some long legs. I am 5'7" and they are about an inch or two past my feet. That is okay, I just pulled them up higher. I have a difficult time deciding what size clothes I need because I have lost 60  pounds over the last few months and I have to guess. Some xlarge fit, some don't. These seem to be plenty roomy for me with room leftover. I like them. They are soft and feel good.

title: Love the look of the dress
text: And I love the color. They call it ginger, and it is gorgeous. It seems to run small, however. I couldn't shimmy my behind in it. So, I am going to hold on to it until I can. I love the look.

title: I love this tank
text: This is such a nicely detailed tank. I ended up getting two of them. In different sizes. I am on a diet and I like it so much, when I lose more weight, I want to be able to continue wearing the cami tank. The sizing chart in the pictures area, is what you want to use to get the size you need. This is 100% polyester. Follow washing instructions for best results. I wash as instructed and gently dry and hang immediately to make sure I don't have wrinkles.

title: Every tunic or blouse from Cyanstyle is cute
text: I have quite a few of this brand and I like them. They are great for work or dates. You can match them with leggings or pants or jeans and they will look great.

title: Fits but doesn't do much for my back and sides
text: I have been losing weight. What I have found, is that I have back fat and side fat that is not going down as quickly as other parts of my body. I love the bra, but the straps do not do anything to enhance my neck area and sides. But I got that solved too. I purchased a compression back and arm piece. And when I wear that, I look great.

title: Super cute and very light and breezy
text: This is a great summer dress. It is easy, breezy and very light. Under the light fabric, is an attached slip that fills in the areas you need to hide. This is a pretty dress that you can go to any dress function and look great. The spaghetti straps easily hold up the top. The ruffled top is cute. Unfortunately, the dress runs small.

title: I do not like the belted area
text: This dress is cute. Except the belted area. There is not enough of the wide fabric where the belt ties to completely cover the front, as shown in the picture. So, I would say it runs small. I think I much prefer the unbelted dress in the same fabric.

title: Another dress that runs small
text: This dress is not my favorite of the summer dresses by Elise Bloom. I don't like the top piece and I don't like the bottom and I don't like that it doesn't fit according to their size chart.

title: Love this top
text: This top is thicker than you would think. I can wear a regular bra with the top, which is good for me, but I can also wear a racerback. It has a nice look to it and I like the cold shoulder look.

title: Love these coverups
text: I have a number of these coverups. They are cute. They are also cotton and some have tassels. Others don't. They are somewhat sheer, especially in the lighter colors but they do the job they were designed to do.

title: Unusual but attractive
text: This dress is pleated in the front. Kind of like a swoosh. It is a midi length. It is also comfortable and you can wear it as a casual dress or dress it up as a more stylish look. It is all in the accessories.

title: I like the look of this dress
text: Even though this is 100% polyester, it feels nice and looks good. The flounce on the hem and ruffles on the top really make this an eyecatcher and the bright color gives it a party look. I like this dress. Make sure you follow the laundering instructions

title: I don't care for this dress
text: The back just doesn't look right. It looks like the seamstress made a big mistake. The front is okay but would look better without the neck ribbon. The girl will be wearing this and I am sure she will love it.

title: Nicely made crop leg pants
text: This material is faux suede and the waist is nice with elastic to give you a nice looking waist. The pants are more like culottes but they can call them cropped. They have a nice flow to the fabric when you walk.

title: runs small

title: Durable, attractive and perfectly sewn wallet
text: If you are purchasing the Protectif RFID blocking wallet as a gift, know that is is packaged in a very nice looking box.  Since it is wrapped in a sheet of tissue paper and placed inside a cellophane bag, you might want to consider removing the bag before presenting it as a gift.  Once out of the bag, box and tissue paper, revealed is a really mice brown leather wallet that is not the softest or smoothest of leather, however it is perfectly manufactured.  I'm very picky about seams and stitching, so it was an enormous relief to see that everything was straight, stitched evenly and finished without a flaw.  Having a number of slots for cards, a flap which separates and protects both sides of the wallet, and a slot for monetary bills, you can feel the liner which gives an additional somewhat stiff texture to the wallet.  The color brown is appealing and the Protectif logo is embedded at the lower right corner of the wallet's exterior.  I expect that if the wallet is carried in a pocket, it will become less deep with the leather flattening as it is worn.  I was provided a sample for my honest evaluation.

title: Simple elegance at an affordable price

As with all other BUREI watches I've seen, the quality is simply outstanding and I don't know how they sell these at such an affordable price.  The elegant simplicity of this watch provides a very easy to read face, including the day of the week and date of the month in a small window.  Should you rely on the second hand, the markers are quite visible, so you likely won't have to strain too much to track those ticks. title: They work, but not the best design
text:
I love the idea of heated gloves as my fingers get cold when playing in the snow with my kids. My wife has a heated jacket that has a similar idea- there's a battery pack that gets wired up inside and then an external button that activates and glows different colors to indicate what mode it is in. This is the same thing, but on two hands (so double the battery packs and switches!).
The jacket version is vastly superior to this in my opinion. To be clear, it DOES work, but there are some design flaws that make it a little frustrating. For starters, the battery pack uses AA cells and not a USB rechargeable pack like other heated items in this style. That's fine, except that the pack is very bulky and hard to get to when you need to change them. There is a zipper pouch that houses it, and you have to really dig around with your fingers to get it out and in. And there's a good chance you'll have to replace them every couple of times you wear this. There is also a "master power" switch on the battery pack, which I guess prevents accidentally pressing the power on when storing the gloves as well as preventing background power drain. If left on, the pack will drain your battery even if the glove's heating function is turned off, so you need to dig it out every time and hit the switch (found this out the hard way).
Not only is that annoying, it is bulky and won't contour with your arm since it is a square pack. See the attached picture, on my arm that carries my watch, the pack creates this awkward bulge. And it isn't that the gloves are too small on me, in fact they are a bit big on me in every other way.
The LED on the gloves also aren't very visible when outside in the snow. I kept questioning whether or not my gloves were on or if in the wrong mode... a few times one had turned itself off perhaps by either the battery dying or accidentally hitting the button. Using them at night solves this, but what if you're outside in the brightly reflected snow? In contrast, my wife's heated jacket is visible.
I was going to give this 4 stars because it's just mildly inconvenient and still functional, but after using it a couple of times and finding the batteries are already dead, I decided against putting even more batteries into it and just using them as normal gloves. For that, you can get much better fitting gloves for the price.
So, if you really need heated gloves on the cheap, they're OK. But they really could be so much better.

text:

Aided with long sleeves and long pants I could wade through the swarms and look for mushrooms, but the screen ended up being a hinderance in being able to see mushrooms on the forest floor so I ended up pulling it up a lot. In the end, the search was still a failure, but a far more comfortable failure.

We also took it on a weekend trip to the bourndary waters and it served well enough during the twilight hours. It is lightweight, reasonably one size fits all and interestingly designed. I like that the net tucks into the zippered pouch on the top of the head and, while I would not want my high school crush to see me wearing it, it looks ok. It definitely feels rugged enough to last us for the rest of our mosquito needs. All in all, we like it, but it is still annoying enough that we can't love it. title: I wish the strips were a little bit wider or use on non paper masks
text:
These little strips really came in handy for my family this weekend and I think parts of the rest of this week.

I live in the Portland Oregon area and we are experirncing a terrible "Super Massive" Smoke Event. Since we don't have respirators we used this strips with resusable cloth masks and insertable filters to get our mail, meet the grocery delivery person and take out garbage out.

The strips are easy to use and I think they really helped keep some of the toxic smoke out of our mouths and noses.

My one complaint is that they are not very wide and because of the thickness of our resusable cloth face masks there isn't very much leeway when you line them up along the edges of your mask and onto your skin.

Something else you should be aware of is to not use this on skin that has been recently moisturized. My skin is super duper dry so the stickers were solid on my face but my husbands nose was kinda greasy since he had taken a shower a few hours previous and I think if it hadn't turned cool and he'd begun to perspire the sticker would have popped right off like a ball on a water slide.

So about skin irritation; I didn't have any and I wore this for almost 40 minutes. I have such dry skin that I use Eucerin on my face and it didn't even leave any marks, so it is super gentle.

I tried using these with my glasses and they didn't fog up but I had to double some of the stickers to stop my breath from escaping the mask.

Cost - Obviously buying a fitted mask would be more cost effective if you have to wear a mask to work or for anything more than an hour here and there. But these are pretty great for the interim.

title: An apron that fits plus size bodies!
text:
I am rating this based on several criteria, first off that it covers me enough that I can cook, even messy foods without staining my clothes.

1. Wide enough to cover my front and protect it from splashes or smears? The answer is yes! It does fully cover my front. There is even a enough yardage that the apron wraps around to my back. I am 5'7" and usually wear a size 22 womens and this was a good fit for me.

2. Sturdy, stain protecting fabric? Yes, again. It has a fine weave and feels like a scratchy woven fabric and it did resist staining, even when I was making a rather messy and green, salsa verde.

3. Comfortable - Not really, for one odd reason, the straps that hold up the top are so so short so to wear the apron they end up with the neckline right up against my neck and this fabric is pretty itchy. I might even say it has more in common with a burlap sack then a smooth linen blazer. I ended up having to wear a silky kerchief to protect my neck from a rash-y, irritated and scraped skin breakout. It was like trying to wear a christmas wreath on my neck, so itchy and awful!

4. Style - I like the millenium pink color and I also like the large front pockets. I can fit a lot of things inside, like my phone, a clean tissue, a spoon. It is just so nice to have a real pocket on an item for a woman and I wasn't really expecting it. I also really like that it has coverage of my top. So often aprons have such a tiny little front coverage area and it can end up with a one-boob-covered situation. I really hate that and it has had disastrous effects on some of my nicest shirts.

5. Washing - I tossed this in with delicates on cold. Then I let it air dry. It dried really fast, so that was perfect as I was down to just one other apron and it isn't as sturdy and spill proof as this one.

6. Giftability - I think this is a nice apron for someone who really enjoys cooking and wants more protection from food stains. But I think this could also be good for a painter or crafter looking to protect their clothes.

title: Perfect for Wyoming Winters!
text:
First off, I'm a woman with larger hands so it's difficult to find decent gloves that both fit my hands and that are also stylish ('cause let's be honest, it's always nice for gloves to not only do their job but look good doing it). Well, I stumbled across these and decided to give 'em a go. Man am I glad I did!

They were delivered quickly which was very much appreciated given a heavy storm.. perfect timing. That storm presented me with the opportunity to put them to the test immediately.

I purchased the large and they fit my larger hands, well.. like a glove. I couldn't ask for a better fit. I usually get gloves that are either 1) too small (most gloves I try) where the stitching for the web between my fingers is at least an inch above my actual web so I find myself always pushing them down which causes the stitching to give out prematurely.. or 2) too large (whenever I wear my husband's gloves) where the stitching comes down to my web but the fingers are too long and I have at least an inch (usually closer to two inches) sticking out beyond the tips of my fingers which causes me to drop anything I might try to pickup. Needless to say, finding the perfect gloves has been a long, seemingly endless battle for me.

But these gloves! Oh yes! They fit! They are so soft inside and out and the color is a nice neutral color that goes with practically anything. The stitching meets my web, there is no excess material extending past my finger tips and they are lined with some of the softest fleece I've ever felt.

Back to the storm.. I wore these gloves while we bucked about a 1/2 cord of firewood. It was cold (14F, 3F with wind chill) and wet as the wood pile had snow from a previous storm on it and it was beginning to snow again. So these gloves kept my hands comfortably warm.. even after they became visibly soaked. Since they are not specifically described as waterproof, I wasn't sure how they'd hold up to the wet snow but they ended up drying out and, other than being a little dirty, looked like they just came out of the packaging.

Their stitching is impressive. There are no uncomfortable bumps or lumps that some gloves tend to have along the fingers or fingertips and the stitching around the thumb and in the palm area is very well done and appears it will survive what I need to ask of them.

Bottom line... I highly recommend these gloves! I do believe they will withstand our infamously harsh Wyoming Winters, so they should be good for you too!

title: Handy headwear for chilly days, but snug and definitely not for windy days or extreme cold.
text:
I've only had this a few days but used it quite a bit (we're having a cold snap!) and it's handy and versatile. I like that the neck part is long, so you can either bunch it up like in the picture or tuck the bottom under the collar of your coat and zip your coat up to keep your neck extra cozy. I was hoping the neck piece could be slipped over my nose easily, but with the hood up if just doesn't work well. You CAN, but if the hood is up it makes it bulge out or fall off unless you scrunch up the draw chords (which I think makes your face look like it's poking out out a sphincter). I like that I can flip the hood back and just use the neck part, then just slip the hood back on if my ears get cold - saves me having to stop what I'm doing and look for a hat.
It's of medium quality construction (fine for the price) and very useful for the right weather conditions. It's warm unless there's wind, which seems to cut through it pretty easy and chill my ears. But that also lets the air move so my head doesn't sweat or get over-hot, which is nice. Definitely not the thing for super cold (below 20F) weather or if there's a chilly wind. The faux fur is pretty soft and feels nice, and lines the entire hood and neck (not just around the face like many hoods) which I like.... even though it's not enough to keep the wind out, it does feel nice to wear. It's snug on me and I have a small head for an adult. It'd be cuter if the hood were a little looser. Would be cozy on a kid - definitely not for anyone with a big head.

Overall a fine buy for the money, but it's something I'll use while working outside on cold but not very windy days - I'll definitely choose something else for around town.
