I was expecting (hoping) it would lay in a more flowing way so I could cover the seam. The collar weighed more then the entire top. May look better in black or a dark color, but the lighter color is a no go. The mocha was a very light greyish tan. I think it's just the wrong type of fabric for this style.

title: Small fits like XXX-LARGE. it's enormous.
text: I love the oatmeal knit with all the different color threads and it could have been a cute heavy sweater if it wasn't ruined by ridiculous sizing. I measured it at 24" wide flat. It's not a little big, it's enormous. I couldn't fill it if I weighed 200 lbs. For reference I am 5'3" and 120 lbs and have been heavy so I know this sweater would be way too big on me even if I had not lost over 45 lbs. I don't own anything nearly this big and my wardrobe goes all the way up to a size 16. It also has holes along the bottom, which I thought was a defect at first glance.

title: Turtleneck that doesn't add chins!
text:
I LOVED this top in a medium, however, the medium fit a bit to tight in the chest area. I have a 36DD chest and just reordered it in a large. I love turtlenecks, but they tend to add more chins than I would like. This one works though. It's not as heavy as a cowl neck and so flattering. Who knew? I never tried a funnel neck before and now i can finally enjoy that high collar style that I love so much once again. Almost forgot to mention the nice heavy soft cotton feel. It is a bit shorter and I would imagine it will shrink when washed. That is my only concern, but the shorter length is also part of the charm of this style top.
----UPDATE-----
I was so confident I would love this top in a size larger I ordered it in black and white. While I love the weight of the fabric it plays against the whole look when the top is just too big and boxy. It looses its "kittenish" appeal and just becomes this big awkwardly fitting top on me. The sleeves are very wide all the way down to the wrist and the cuteness factor just turned into boxy and stiff. One of the armholes is cut wrong on the white one and it pulls awkwardly. I don't think this top is a good fit for me. I am so disappointed.

title: Just a plain lycra blend Cami. NO support.
text: It's  okay as a basic layering cami with a reversible neckline. I like that part, otherwise it offers no support. If you are expecting a shelf bra or a light support shape wear garment, this isn't it. At least not the one I received. The fabric is soft and stretchy. Not see through unless really stretched, but the medium did not stretch out much on me. I have a slender build. It wasn't exactly what I was expecting based upon the product description so I am a little bummed about that. Plan on wearing it tucked into to something because it rolls up pretty bad.

title: Looks AMAZING! Not great support for running if you have a large chest.
text:
The Due East Apparel Women's Medium Support Mesh Cover Sports Bra is probably one of the best looking sports bra I have ever tried. It looks amazing even though I was sent the incorrect size. However, I am not going to let that detract from the my review of this product because I really like the quality and look. I have a large chest and It would be fine for yoga and low impact exercise, but not supportive enough for running. I ordered a size medium and was sent a size small and was somehow able to stuff myself into it. For reference I am 116 lbs and 36DD. The size small looked like a push-up bra and I was spilling out of it. A medium would have been perfect. The wide elastic band fit my frame perfectly and If I were a B or C cup it would have been fine.

Pro tip: The crossover straps will be challenging if you try to pull it on over your head so step into it and pull it up as you would for shape wear. The inner pads are placed awkwardly and seem unnecessary. You can pull them out and the bra will look amazing.

title: How is this even possible? Turned my boxy shape into an hourglass figure.
text: I'm a huge fan of shape wear and I must say I have never experienced anything quite like  before. The moonlight elves Women Body Shaper High Waist Butt Lifter Tummy Control Shape-wear Panties has boning at the waist and I can really feel the compression on my torso. It is literally creating a rounder shape on my flattish rear end. Pretty amazing.  For reference I am 5'3"/115 lbs/36DD... and yes, I need shape wear at my age. After losing 45 lbs my spare skin creates almost as many issues as my fat did. Muffin top fat or flab is still muffin top! Having been both heavy, thin and every where in between, I can tell you this will work miracles if you are heavier. At my current weight it reigns in my loose flabby skin and gives me more of an hour glass shape. I am slender with a boxy shape and middle age speed so that alone is a miracle. . I was sent a size large, which is to long for my body. I was able to cinch it down and can still feel how much compression this offers. It's not that easy to breath while seated, but not as restrictive as the old fashioned girdles, corsets and long line bras of the sixties.  I plan to buy one in a smaller size because I am properly impressed. Especially for the enhancements to my bottom. It literally gave it a shape and created something from  of nothing! I am truly amazed!

title: Maxi to midi length on 5'3" size small.
text: This skirt is a lot longer than the product pic would indicate so I included pictures of how it fit my 5'3" stature. The product description does indicate it is ankle length, but most people tend to pay more attention to the picture. The size small was a perfect fit, unexpected length aside, and the fabric it does have an inner lining so you would not need to wear a slip underneath during the day. It's a well made skirt with an an eclectic look. The fabric is chiffon with gold metallic thread stripes spaced 1/2" apart. It has a graduated hemline that runs from maxi to midi length with a more bohemian styled vibe and would look great with a nice pair of sandals. This skirt would probably be appropriate for an afternoon wedding reception, perhaps on a beach, or lunch at a seaside restaurant. The footwear will determine how dressy or casual you choose to make this look and it can go either way.

title: LOVE! I have finally found the perfect summer hat.
text: I am in love with this adorable summer hat. The trim is vibrantly colored and made of a medium-weight crepe fabric with a beautiful drape. The brim holds its shape without too much floppiness. It looks and feels well made. Honestly,  I am very impressed and wasn't expecting this level of quality. This hat arrived well packaged and it looks flawless. I still can't get over how cute it is.

title: It's cute, but compresses my chest.
text: It's cute, but it compressed my chest in a size medium. It was an iffy size choice for me, and I have noticed that sizing can vary widely between brands so I thought I might be safe with a size medium since I have other Due East sports bras and the size small came so close. For reference I am 5'3", 116 lbs and have a 36DD bust size. It's challenging to find a good quality sports bra that fits all of me. The wideband fit well and I was able to get it on over my head. I usually treat sports bras like shapewear and step into it and pull it up for the easiest access. The pads were overkill on me and I removed them immediately. If you have a smaller bust, the padding is very thick and will increase the appearance of your bustline by a cup size. They remind me of push up bra pads.  I've been delighted with just about all my Due East apparel and have several pieces from their line. The quality is superb and the styles are cutting edge, but his one just wasn't a good fit.

title: Pretty, vibrant and feminine. LOVE!!!!
text:
This Orchid Row Kimono Printed Chiffon Open Front cover-up is made of mid to lightweight chiffon fabric that moves effortlessly and drapes beautifully. The vibrantly colored pattern is very feminine and pretty.
The sizing is generous and would accommodate up to 3X plus sizes with ease. It feels oversized on my petite stature but I can make this work if I leave it untied. I've thought of trying it belted, but the sleeves are too wide for that. If they made this in a wrap style top I would be over the moon!

I truly love this fabulous Kimono and will be getting a lot of enjoyment wearing it. It's a wonderful wardrobe piece that adds fun and flair to jeans and dressier attire.

title: BEST Lightweight ankle socks EVER!
text:
I've received a lot of socks for review and rarely am I impressed. The Panvbo 8 Pairs Womens Crew Socks exceeded all expectations. What makes these anklet socks special?

They are at high-quality lightweight sock that is perfect to wear with sneakers or dressier shoes in my hot climate. Thin, but not cheap! The mesh fabric makes the breatheable and adds a touch of style!

The fit is outstanding on my women's size 7 foot. They would fit smaller and larger feet as well because the fabric has a lot of elasticity, yet doesn't feel restrictive.

The mesh fabric is a nice detail that gives these socks a leg up (pun intended). They are pretty!

They are well made. No question these are quality socks.

8 pairs? Holy cow, these are a bargain!

By now I think you can tell I love these socks and I am hoping I can still find the no-show version. I highly recommend these because they are the BEST SOCKS EVER!

title: Cute and comfortable.
text: I am always looking for a way to keep my long thick hair off my face, and the Jeff & Aimy Women Elastic Headband does an excellent job and looks cute with its bowtie style band in the middle. I have bangs, so it's a really fun look! I have tried other headbands that were so large I was able to use them as belts. This one fits my head so I can use it for its intended purpose! Yay!

title: Shabby and cheap.
text: The Selene Women's Lightweight Robe V-Neck Knit Soft Kimono Sleepwear in size medium was both too large and too small for my 5'3", 116 lb body. The shoulders were too wide and it felt like I was wearing a size large. However, the rest of the garment was too small and could barely accommodate my chest or wrap around my waist. It is made with a thin ribbed t-shirt material that does not feel suitable for a robe. The stitching was uneven with puckering along the sides. The overall look is shabby and cheap, and at nearly $30, I would have returned it had I purchased it.

title: Wouldn't be bad it were the correct size.
text:
I received the DANNE MORA Women's Short Denim Jacket Casual Fashionable Cropped Black Trucker Jacket in the wrong size so I will do my best to review it fairly. Usually, Amazon gets it right when there are no size options to choose. This time I received a size large. For reference, I typically wear a size small or medium.

I have a similar jacket in the correct size in blue denim, and it looks and fits great. Not many woven tops or jackets can accommodate the combination of narrow shoulders and a larger chest and look good. However, this style does.

It fit as a size large should. I lost 40 lbs, so I do know. The quality is excellent, and the fabric has a bit of stretch. It falls just at my natural waist. For reference, I am 5'3" and the length on the arms was just below my wrist bone. The distressed details are not overdone, and It would be a lovely jacket if it were my correct size.

title: G'Day Mate! I'm ready for the Outback.
text:
I am ready for the Aussie Outback with this delightful Jeff & Aimy Western Outback Cowboy Straw Hat. I noticed the decoration on the band was a little off center. Since it is permanently affixed, I am unable to adjust it, It's not that bad, but since I've noticed it my eyes tend to focus on that area. Otherwise, it is a cute hat.
I was very surprised because I have many hats by Jeff & Aimy and the quality has always been superb.

title: Adorable, but runs smaller than expected.
text:
I absolutely adore the Le Mou Women's Cold Shoulder Top with Ruffle Sleeve Detail. It is made using a lightweight polyester material that feels silky soft, and the shoulder cut-outs give it a fun and flirty look. I like that I can have shoulder cutouts without exposing my bra straps.

I am so used to vanity sizing that I took a chance and ordered this in size small. It was my only option. However, it runs a bit smaller than expected and closer to a size x-small. I measured it at 17 1/2" wide at the top. I am wondering if I would require a medium or large in this top in order for it to work.

Even though I have narrow shoulders, my 36DD chest was somewhat flattened because woven fabrics are not forgiving. The fabric won this fight!

It is cute and sexy top, but you may want to size up.

title: Beautifully sequined stunner.  Great for a New Years Eve Party ✨
text: All eyes will be on you in this beautifully sequined stunner  The MEALIYA Women V Neck Sequin Jumpsuit is not only dazzling but very well made and perfect for a New Years Eve party. The lining is soft and comfortable. The sequins do not catch when you walk, and it more wearable than you would think. I am 5'3". 116lbs with a 36DD chest and the size small looks like it was custom made for my body, albeit a bit long. No worries, I happen to have the perfect pair of 5" high glittery gold party shoes that I found on Amazon to complete this look. I am not curvaceous, but this jumpsuit makes me look like I am and I love it even more for that!

title: Sparkly fun and well made - Accommodates petites 🔥
text: Wow, the MEALIYA Party Jumpsuit was a delightful surprise. The size small was pretty forgiving and accommodated even my most ample parts with relative ease. I don't even think I would need to use tape to keep the top in place without exposing more than I would like. For reference, I am 116 lbs, 5'3" with a 36DD chest, and it fits like a dream. At first, I was concerned about the length because the inseam seemed long, but I was able to pull the legs up a little, and they stayed in place without any visible bunching and gathers. I wish all my leggings did that. The sequins/rhinestones are firmly attached. I have no worries about losing any. The lining is soft, comfortable, and forgiving! I even found the perfect shoes to go with this outfit on Amazon. This glittery and fun outfit is well made and sure to dazzle wherever you go... or don't.

title: Sparkly and  easy-to-adjust dangly bracelet
text: The Hugitout Women's Natural Cowrie Shell Bracelet, Handmade Shell Bracelet is lovely and the findings to adjust the bracelet are easy to adjust and hold firmly in place. At the end of the box chain is 25mm CZ bevel set stones that dangle and catch the light. It had a lovely pave set crystals which make this little Cowie shell bracelet a standout. It's very comfortable and the hanging chains stay in place. I have small wrists so it's always nice to find a bracelet that fits. If you're a fan of rose gold, you'll love this sparkly little bracelet.

title: Charming shell bracelet that fits smaller wrists
text: The Hugitout Women's Natural Cowrie Shell Bracelet is a charming little shell bracelet made with natural Cowie shells and a single gold plated shell in the middle. This fun, casual look that will remind you of a seaside vacation and is a perfect accessory for your summer wardrobe. I have small wrists, and I was able to adjust the sizing to fit, so this would also be an excellent gift for a young teen.

title: Love this soft leather bifold wallet
text: First let me say, I am a fan of the Louis Pelle line of leather wallets and have several of their credit card cases and coin purses. Their leather goods are deeply dyed, thick, soft, and the construction has been flawless in every wallet I received. This Louis Pelle Genuine Leather Slim Minimalist Front Pocket RFID Blocking Wallet is no exception. The slots hold my credit cards and ID securely, and I like that it is a bifold style with ample space to hold my cash securely.  It can be used for business cards as well. It's small enough to fit into my tiny purse and or the pocket of my jeans. The fact that it offers RFID protection is a bonus! I am sure I will get many years of enjoyment from this wallet, and I highly recommend it.

title: Left me speechless
text: I am never at a loss for words, but after trying on the Actloe Women V Neck Floral Printed Multicolor Top, I was speechless. I am 5'3", 117 lbs with a 36DD chest and I received a size large which fit loose, as it should since I am usually a size small in vanity sized apparel. I can gauge what a top should look like when sewn correctly, but both sleeves were uneven with an entire inch more armhole and sleeve on one side versus the other. The combination of a boxy style and puffed sleeves would be unflattering on my body type no matter what size it was. I cannot recommend this style to anyone who is top heavy or has broad shoulders. It could work on gals with a narrow frame and a smaller bust, as the model. The low rating is for the lack of quality. I can forgive a style that isn't the best cut for my shape when it is well made.

title: Very tasteful - Well-made and not over-the-top
text:
I apprehensive when I ordered this Liumilac Sequin Splice Bodycon dress and feared it might be over-the-top, but was delighted to find it is very well made and tastefully designed.

I am 5'3", 117 lbs with a 36DD chest and the size medium fit as though it were custom made. The strap over the sequin side is adjustable, but I did not need to change anything. Even if you don't have a larger bust size to fill out the sequin side, I think fashion tape will keep everything securely in place.

This dress is fully lined, so there was nothing scratchy to irritate my skin. It drapes beautifully without clinging in all the wrong places, even without the benefit of shapewear underneath. The length was just below my knees, and the side zipper made slipping in and out of it a breeze.

In all honesty, I am a bit old to be wearing this style, but it could work with a little jacket to cover my upper arms and look still fabulous. This is a lovely dress, and I highly recommend it.

title: Comfortable casual knit dress with pockets
text:
The KIRUNDO casual knit split style maxi dress is soft, comfortable and has pockets. I received this dress in size large, and it fit true to size in American sizing. That made it too big for me because I am 5'3", 117 lbs with a 36DD chest and would typically wear a size small in this type of knitwear (US sizing).

It's a boxy cut and not especially flattering except that the extra fabric in the pockets adds a little shape to the hip area. Despite the crisp laser cut holes, it was a nothing type of dress that looked kind of frumpy on me. I don't need any help in that department at my age.

I can usually make anything work, but I am at a loss with this dress because It's doesn't even work as loungewear.

I cinched it in back to get an idea of what this dress might look like if it were closer to the right size and it didn't look too bad.

However, I am not a fan of maxi dresses, and the split front panel felt a bit annoying as I walked. It felt like I had to kick something out of my way with every step.

The overall quality was decent, but this just wasn't the right style or size.

title: Cute and comfy
text: I have to admit it's cute and comfy. I lived in this style during the '70s. I loved it then and now. However, now it would be more of a loungewear item than an outdoor fashion statement for me.  For reference, I am 5'3", 117 lbs with a 36DD chest and received a size medium, which fits perfect. It's not vanity sized. This jumper is the type of style that looks best on pear-shaped ladies with narrow frames. I, on the other hand, am a top-heavy apple shaped gal with a flattish rear end. For me, it's more nostalgic than flattering. The fabric is thin and soft, and It's lined so your undies won't show through. This is a fun casual summer style that's perfect as a beach cover-up or poolside. Honestly, I wasn't expecting to like this, but I love it!

title: Fit large and styled for pear shaped figures
text:
I thought I would love the Ocean Blues Women's Adjustable High Waisted Bikini Bottom Tummy Control Tankini Swimsuit because the style seemed perfect to contour my core and hide my problem areas,

The bottoms I received fit much too large, and the cut was triangular, which seems more suited for pear-shaped figures with wider hips and larger thighs.

I am more apple-shaped with slender hips, thin legs, a wider waist, and more tummy than booty.

For reference, I am 5'3", 117 lbs and received this tankini bottom in size medium. It fit me like a generous size large. The leg openings were too large, and there were significant gaps between the suit and my skin.

I wear a size medium in one piece swimwear, and a size small in leggings. I have to assume different size rules apply to swimwear separates, and a size small, or x-small would have been the correct fit since I wear a size 2 in women's jeans.

I am going to base my rating on the overall quality of this swimsuit bottom. They are well made, and the seams are sewn straight with no loose or hanging threads, They would probably look lovely in the correct size and especially with the right shape.

title: Very lightweight and thin fabric
text:
I received this top in a size X-large, and wear a size small. It may work as casual loungewear or a nighty. The fabric is soft, and the crochet work is pretty, albeit heavy for this very lightweight and thin fabric.

I think it is the wrong fabric for this style in this size. If I were still heavy, it would be clingy and reveal every bump and bulge. Honestly, I don't think it's an attractive look for me in any size. It is comfortable but looks and feels cheap.

title: Oversized sunglasses
text: These polarized sunglasses came well packaged with a nice pinch top case. This aviator style has a very masculine look, and they are, indeed, oversized. If you like large frames, you'll love these. Get yourself a pair of cheap sunglasses.

title: These socks ROCK!
text:
These socks ROCK! I am not much of a hiker, but I am a runner, and I am always looking for the latest and greatest running socks/technical socks. I feel like I have just hit the jackpot with these.

I live in a warmer climate and don't ofter wear crew socks, but that is mostly because they don't always stay in place. These do!

I love the way they feel with perfect arch support and cushioning at the heel and toe. Very supportive, breathable and extremely comfortable!

They are precision made for the left and right foot, and each sock is marked with L and R. above the toes. There are no seams above the toes to irritate my skin during a long run or hike. They give me happy feet!

I received this in a size medium, and they fit my size 7 woman's feet perfectly. They are sharp-looking, high-quality socks and I VERY highly recommend them!

title: comfortable lightweight and  buttery soft
text:

title: nicer than I anticipated but not much support
text:

It's also not too cropped or low cut on me which is great! I think it's a little higher priced than other tops I've tried in similar styles, so I removed a star for that reason.

title: Super light frames
text: I like the design of the lenses but the frames are just way too light and thin. Very easy to bend and seem incredibly fragile. They unfortunately aren't the most comfortable either. These are just okay imo.

title: Size down
text: I'm 5'7" 130lbs and I tried these leggings in a small and medium. The small fit well but I think if they had an XS that would work better since I do think these run a bit big. They're  made of a smoother sport fabric with some shine to it. I prefer more cottony fabrics with a matte finish so that's one reason it's not a super favorite of mine. However these leggings do have a seamless waistband and come at a very affordable price. I received a green pair but purchased a black pair with my own money for these reasons. For the price, I definitely think they're worth a try!

title: Okay but not high quality
text: Quality of these is comparable to something you'd see at F21. Not the best and definitely more on the costumes side. For the quality I think you could find earrings such as these for less elsewhere. But if you're in a pinch, the different shapes offer nice variety and if anything they make good backups.

title: Nice and high but color was not flattering on me
text:
Bottoms were actually high waisted in me. I'm 5'7" 130lbs, small fit great. Full coverage bottom.

The color is a little infantile in person and I didn't don't it flattering. Someone else may, but just wasn't for me.

title: Great little hat. Love the fit.
text: This hat is well made and so cute.  It fits well, as expected.  I love the strap, the baby doesn't love it so much, because he can't pull it off easily.  It keeps the sun off of his head when wearing it in the pool.

title: Shorts are cute.  Feel cheap
text: I think the shorts are cute.  They feel cheaply made.  Washed well the first time.  They fit as expected.

title: Needs a wider band for the size of the bra.
text:
It says it's for Full Figures, but it only has 2 hooks. Fuller figure bras need at least 3 hooks. The band is thin in the back. The cups fit as expected. It's not a top quality bra. It's not a good value. You could go to a store like VS or Dillard's and get a nicer bra for the price of this bra. If the band would be wider and more hooks, then I would consider it a better value.

I received the black bra. The color is as described.

title: Comfortable and cute.
text: This is about medium support, not good for a heavy, bouncing workout.  Works great for light workouts. The colors are bright and the fabric is nice.  It fits according to the size chart.

title: Super comfortable!
text: These underwear are super comfortable. They fit well and wash well.  No binding or crawling.  Surprisingly, my daughter loves them!

title: Just ok
text: These aren't very good quality for the price.  For $25, I would expect a softer feeling fur.  The fur is a bit on the long, silky side, but not very plush. Warmth is ok, not as good as it could be.

title: Cute!
text: I received the royal blue. The color is bright and washes well.  I think it looks cute on.  Not sure if the polyester style fabric will make be sweat outdoors, but it very cute.

title: Love the hat. It's a little bit too floppy
text: I love the hat, but it's a little bit too floppy.  It would be nice if it had a little bit more stiffness to it.  It looks very nice on and protects my face from the sun.

title: These lightweight no show socks are nice.
text: The lightweight no show socks are a nice. They fit well and wash well.  The don't slip inside of my shoes.  They are a good value.

title: These are some nice sunglasses for the price.
text: These sunglasses cut the glare.  They are lightweight and look great!  I have gotten more compliments on these big square glasses than any other glasses I have had.

title: Nice product.  The lettering is clear
text: I love the inspirational statement on it. It's a nice quality key chain and the lettering is clear.

title: Cozy and cute the zipper scrstchedmy neck
text: Even with the zipper unzipped, it still made the top uncomfortsble.  I like the look of it and it's warm, just not comfortable.

title: Cute but strong smell
text: I've washed these 3 times, I even washed with vinegar and the odor of the dye is still strong.  They are cute and fit as expected, but i won't wear them because of the smell.

title: Cute shorts, fit well
text: These sorts are cute and they fit well.  Stylish

title: Nice sweater
text: This sweater is nice for the price. It's warm, yet not too heavy. I machine washed it in a lingerie bag and let it air dry.  It came out great!

title: Cute, comfortable
text: Top is cute and comfortably fits.  It's true to size.  This top can be worn alone or with a cute jacket.  It cam be dressed up or dressed down.

title: Small
text: Love it! I will wear it to work!

title: Too long!!
text: The product was too long even with heels! The material is stretchy, but not in a good way. It feels cheap. Could have been really cute if it was good quality.

title: Fitted
text: Order up! They should not be this small in a large!

title: Get what you pay for…
text:
Poorly made, fell apart out of the package. I didn’t think I would have to put it together to wear it…
Do not purchase this item. Returning.

title: Five Stars
text: Broke a few days after I purchased unfortunately.

title: Ok product
text: I sent this product back, I liked how I could wear a pony tail through it but I wouldn’t wear it enough to keep it.

title: Color issue
text: I just didn’t like the coloring, thought it would be more tan/brown but it was grey.

title: Beautiful color, but DOLMAN-like and nearly NO SLEEVE
text: I returned the shirt I purchased. My main problems are 1- the 'sleeves' aren't really sleeves.  There is barely anything that falls over the shoulder.  Less than a cap sleeve even.  2- It's much like a dolman fit, where the arm hole falls very low. Just doesn't work on my figure.  3- The front isn't quite long enough for me. I'm 5'11'' and I like to have extra coverage in the front region.  This falls a little too short for my torso/hip/area. ;)  The color was beautiful (teal) and the material felt comfortable and, though it arrived incredibly wrinkled, seemed like it would fall nicely after some ironing.

title: Arms VERY THIN. OK quality, especially for price.
text: I want to like it. It's so cute!  BUT, I couldn't even get my arm past my elbow into the sleeve. Fail. The elbow patches and seams are OK, but patches are fraying.  It's expected for the price.  I wish my arms were toothpicks.

title: Weird. Short and thick.
text: Odd! The sweater is not long and the pockets are strange. I am. 5'11", but it's not long at all, barely covers my butt. The pockets are THICK and aren't sewn in so they flop open. I was able to get a partial refund and hope to maybe make this into an ugly sweater.

title: Year round purse/tote for your use.
text: There are some really good features: very soft leather, interesting seams, sturdy handles, not too wide bottom.  There is a center zippered divider and one other zippered compartment as well as 2 open pouches.  There are no pockets on the outside.  I love soft, slouchy purses and the color of this one is neutral, and would be good for both summer and winter.  I plan to use it as a tote and probably wouldn't even close the main zipper on the top, which is actually quite hidden.  There are no metal "feet" on the bottom for protection.  All-in-all, I am happy with my purchase.  There is an odor on opening the package (there is a dust cover) but it is dissipating.  The interior fabric is dark, shiny and is a bit stiff. I am not petite and although I can wear it as a shoulder bag, it's a bit tight and uncomfortable and will use as a tote, which I planned on doing anyway.

title: OK headband
text: Bright color! A little small for my head and it rides up in back unless I have a ponytail. Fabric is soft.

title: Comfortable and useful
text: Versatile, utilitarian, and attractive!  You can wear in multiple ways and are perfect for hard work days, the gym, and bad hair days. Love the patterns and can coordinate with multiple pants/tops.  Very comfortable and don't ride up in the back if you wear the front down on your forehead somewhat.

title: Cased readers - pretty good value
text: Nice cases, good price for 3 pairs.  Not spring hinged and quality of lenses was just OK.  They are certainly wide enough frames for any head.

title: Nice, soft, basic T-shirt
text: Recipient says it is soft, and washes well.  Color is nice and fit is as expected.

title: Favorite hat!
text: I bought this exact hat some time ago.  It quickly became my favorite hat... it fits and looks great! It even has nice satin lining!  Its fairly light wieght which makes it great for summertime.  Unfortunately, that old hat got stained from constant wearing. Went looking for another... I think they quit making them, though, because for awhile, I couldn't get my size (xxl). When they finally showed 1 available, I snagged it!  This one came in and fits and looks just like my old one. There's a tag on the inside that says 150th anniversary... so I think it may be a limited edition or something.  If you can get your size... get it while you can!

title: Soft and comfy Christmas socks
text:
Christmas themed socks! (My wife loves this kind of stuff...) One pair has reindeer on a white background and the other pair has a red background with little Christmas trees and "elf hats?" Not sure about that one...

The socks themselves seem well made... soft and stretchy, I'm sure they'll be comfortable for her. Just thick enough to help keep her warm, but not so thick as to crowd her foot inside her shoes. Nice socks.

title: Purple sequins adorn the bill and wing color...
text: Got this for my daughter... beautiful embroidered butterfly embroidered on the front with purple sequins supplying wing coloring - the bill and button on top are adorned with matching sequins making this a fun and colorful hat. Size is adjustable.

title: No discoloration - effective waterproofing treatment for suede and nubuck
text:
I'm really impressed bythis product. I was concerned that it might discolor the materials beingtreated, but have not seen that on anything.

I started with some suede hiking boots... I followed the directions and applied in 2 coats, allowing them to dry overnight. When I returned the next day, water beaded up and rolled off the suede... and the suede itself remained soft and pliable.
Very nice.

I followed that by treating a couple of nubuck and suede casual shoes... same great experience. Definitely recommended.

title: Goes on easy - no discoloration - waterproofs effectively
text: This does a great job. I've used on canvas slip ins and mesh sneakers.  It goes on easy and once dry, its virtually invisible... but the shoes are waterproofed. Great product.

title: Soft and stretchy - comfortable fit for anyone
text: Very nice... soft and stretchy. Its lightweight and the fact that its so stretchy makes it very comfortable and should fit just about anyone. The material is thin enough that it doesn't seem to hinder breathing. Quality workmanship.

title: Simple elegant style - soft and comfortable
text: My wife loves the nightgown. Its light and airy, soft and comfortable. Not really a lacy style, but with satin trim at the color it gives it a simple elegance- fit is spot on. Recommended.
